summary: A consortium led by Select Medical's own executive chairman alongside private equity firm Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe completed a take-private deal valuing the specialty hospital operator at about $3.9 billion, delisting it from the NYSE.

headline: FDA clears AI tool that spots hidden heart disease from routine ECGs
summary: Pathway Labs' EchoNext became the first AI system cleared to flag structural heart conditions like heart failure and valve disease directly from a standard 12-lead ECG, reportedly outperforming cardiologists in large-scale validation testing.

headline: Pearl Health raises $110 million to expand Medicare AI platform
summary: The value-based care technology company closed a $50 million Series C led by Andreessen Horowitz plus a $60 million credit facility, funding it will use to grow its AI-driven risk and workflow tools for providers managing Medicare patients.

headline: Mayo Clinic's longtime CEO to depart at year's end
summary: Dr. Gianrico Farrugia announced he will step down as Mayo Clinic's president and CEO by the end of 2026 after leading the health system since 2019, with a successor expected to be named in November.

headline: Asia-Pacific digital health investment splits sharply toward infrastructure over startups
summary: Analysis of first-quarter 2026 deal flow found roughly $2.65 billion in strategic digital health investment across Asia-Pacific compared to just $244 million in traditional venture funding, signaling investors are prioritizing healthcare data and AI infrastructure over early-stage startups.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance notches second-biggest first half on record
summary: Settled catastrophe bond issuance topped roughly $16 billion by mid-2026, putting the insurance-linked securities market on pace for one of its strongest half-years ever as investor appetite for cat risk keeps growing.

headline: QBE buys out its Indian joint-venture partner to take full control of local insurer
summary: Australia's QBE Insurance Group completed the purchase of the remaining 51% stake in Raheja QBE General Insurance from building-materials firm Prism Johnson for about $34 million, giving QBE full ownership after IRDAI approval and setting up a rebrand of the unit.

headline: Lloyd's spells out 2026 supervisory priorities as it pushes a capital-efficiency strategy
summary: Lloyd's of London outlined its market oversight priorities for 2026, including new credit-risk codes for the year of account and an updated realistic disaster scenario data collection, as the marketplace executes a five-year strategy centered on underwriting discipline and returns.

headline: Carriers reposition AI as a loss-prevention tool, not just a pricing engine
summary: Insurance executives are increasingly framing artificial intelligence's biggest payoff as helping policyholders avoid losses before they happen, rather than only sharpening how underwriters price and select risk.

headline: Gallagher deepens Canadian presence by snapping up Western Canada commercial broker
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. acquired Burnaby, British Columbia-based Wilson M. Beck Insurance Services, a commercial brokerage focused on construction, real estate, surety and mining, continuing its steady pace of tuck-in acquisitions across North America.

headline: Asset manager Arrow Global buys into the MGA boom with Fusion Specialty deal
summary: Alternative investment firm Arrow Global Group agreed to acquire UK-based Fusion Specialty Group to expand its specialty insurance platform, part of a broader wave of private capital flowing into managing general agents as rates in some lines firm.

headline: Lockton stacks up senior specialty hires in Singapore to build out its Asia bench
summary: Broker Lockton has made six senior appointments across Asia since June, including a regional cyber advisory head and a marine and transportation growth leader based in Singapore, as it builds a specialty platform to compete for complex regional risks.

headline: Malibu Life Holdings completes TruSpire acquisition, launching U.S. annuity arm
summary: London-listed insurance holding company Malibu Life Holdings closed its purchase of TruSpire Retirement Insurance Company, rebranding it Malibu Life USA to serve as its origination platform for the U.S. retail annuity market, with an inaugural product launch targeted for September.

headline: Assured Guaranty enters annuity reinsurance market via Warwick Re deal
summary: Bond insurer Assured Guaranty is expanding into annuity reinsurance through the acquisition of Bermuda-based Warwick Re, marking its first move into the life and annuity reinsurance space.

headline: India's insurers begin transition to new Ind AS accounting standards
summary: India's insurance sector started moving to new Ind AS accounting rules mandated by IRDAI for greater reporting transparency; standalone health insurers adopted the framework first, while LIC and major life and general insurers secured a one-year exemption.

headline: Pooled employer plans become recordkeepers' main growth engine for 2026
summary: Cerulli research finds 60% of retirement recordkeepers now offer pooled employer plan (PEP) services, with firms expecting PEPs to drive 20-40% of new business growth this year as the structure moves from niche to mainstream.

headline: Goldman Sachs Asset Management's insurer AUM hits $651 billion as private-asset appetite grows
summary: Goldman Sachs Asset Management now manages $651 billion in general-account assets for insurance clients, and its latest insurer survey found 62% plan to increase allocations to private assets in 2026.

headline: Advisor360° unveils AI-native wealth management operating system
summary: Wealthtech platform Advisor360° launched what it calls an AI-native operating system for wealth managers, aiming to embed AI-driven workflows across planning, portfolio and client-service functions rather than bolting AI onto legacy tools.

headline: US P/C industry posts best full-year underwriting result in a decade for 2025
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry recorded a 93 combined ratio for 2025 -- its best in ten years -- with direct premiums written growing 5% to about $1.11 trillion and personal lines underwriting income jumping to $61.2 billion.

headline: UK regulators unveil plans for a globally competitive captive insurance regime
summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority laid out proposals for an "internationally competitive" UK captive insurance regime, opening a consultation that runs through October 14, 2026.

headline: Zurich reshuffles Asia Pacific commercial insurance leadership
summary: Zurich Insurance Group named Sean Walker head of commercial insurance and chief technical officer for Asia Pacific and hired Liam Burrell from AIG as head of commercial insurance for Asia and Singapore CEO, as the carrier builds out its regional commercial business.

headline: AI-powered MGA Mile Auto acquires The Insurance House
summary: Mile Auto, a pay-per-mile auto insurance MGA, acquired agency The Insurance House effective July 1, creating a combined operation with nearly $100 million in annual premium serving over 55,000 policyholders across roughly 1,600 agencies.

headline: Fiduciary Services Group makes its third TPA acquisition of 2026
summary: Retirement-plan consolidator Fiduciary Services Group acquired New Jersey-based TPA RetireWell Administrators, which oversees more than 425 retirement plans, marking FSG's third such deal this year.

headline: Cover Genius raises $100 million, valuation climbs to $1.9 billion
summary: Embedded-insurance infrastructure provider Cover Genius raised $100 million backed by Vista Credit Partners, funding that will expand its AI-driven personalization, agentic distribution and automated claims capabilities.

headline: Feathery raises $30 million Series A to expand AI decisioning into insurance and wealth management
summary: Feathery, an AI operating and decisioning platform for financial services firms, raised a $30 million Series A led by Portage Ventures and Index Ventures, with backers including Allstate Strategic Ventures and Bain Capital Ventures.

headline: Kayna and Willis partner to close subcontractor insurance coverage gaps
summary: Embedded-insurance platform Kayna teamed up with broker Willis to target coverage gaps among subcontractors, aiming to make it easier to verify and bind insurance for gig and trade-based construction workers.

headline: AI-focused startups capture 97% of disclosed insurtech funding in H1 2026
summary: The Simon-Kucher Insurtech Tracker found AI-focused companies took in $820 million, or 97% of all disclosed insurtech funding, in the first half of 2026, as investor attention shifts from purchase-flow digitization to rebuilding insurers' operating infrastructure.

headline: Compliance-AI startup Norm AI raises $120 million, crosses unicorn threshold
summary: Norm AI closed a $120 million Series C led by Khosla Ventures at a $1.2 billion valuation, reaching unicorn status less than three years after founding.

headline: Insurity names Jatin Atre as CEO, succeeding Jeff Clarke
summary: Insurance software provider Insurity appointed Jatin Atre, previously its president since January, as chief executive officer; outgoing CEO Jeff Clarke moves to executive chairman as the company continues a $50 million AI R&D push.

headline: CVS Caremark settles all outstanding FTC pharmacy-benefit litigation
summary: CVS Health's Caremark PBM reached a global settlement with the FTC resolving rebate, pharmacy-network and vertical-integration allegations, agreeing to steer patients to lowest-cost drug options and stop restricting independent "hub" pharmacies.

headline: ACA marketplace insurers propose median 14% premium hike for 2027
summary: Preliminary filings from 77 ACA marketplace insurers across 16 states show a median proposed premium increase of 14% for 2027, the second-highest requested rate change since 2018, driven by rising medical costs and the expiration of enhanced premium tax credits.

headline: Wave of insurers sue CMS over 2026 Medicare Advantage Star ratings recalculation
summary: Alignment Healthcare and SCAN filed new suits against CMS seeking higher Medicare Advantage Star ratings, joining a wider wave of litigation that followed Clover Health's May court win over how CMS calculated quality measures.

headline: UCSF Health launches AI accelerator with Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital
summary: UCSF Health, Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital unveiled "UCSF Health Converge," an accelerator embedding startups with clinicians and operators inside the academic health system to build and validate AI tools in live care settings.

headline: Mayo Clinic now runs over 150 AI models across its hospital system
summary: Mayo Clinic has deployed more than 150 AI models system-wide, including "Record Time," a tool that generates chronological patient summaries and saves physicians five to thirty minutes of prep per visit.

headline: CMS signals plan to overhaul how it pays for clinical software and AI
summary: CMS indicated in proposed 2027 hospital-outpatient and physician-fee rules that it intends to build a more consistent payment structure for clinical software and AI tools tied to their measured impact on patient outcomes.

headline: LIMRA: U.S. individual life insurance sales extend strong growth into Q1 2026
summary: LIMRA's first-quarter 2026 data show individual life insurance sales continuing to build on 2025's record pace, with indexed universal life remaining the fastest-growing segment.

headline: Indexed universal life premium rises 14% in Q1 2026, extending a multi-year record run
summary: IUL new annualized premium reached $1.1 billion in the first quarter, up 14% year over year, with six of the ten largest carriers posting double-digit growth as insurers widen distribution.

headline: UK bulk annuity market tracking toward record £70 billion of pension risk transfer in 2026
summary: Advisers expect UK defined-benefit schemes to transfer roughly £50 billion via buy-ins and buyouts plus £20 billion of longevity swaps this year, with more than 150,000 members moving into individual annuity contracts.

headline: UK's PRA to review insurers' handling of solvency-triggered bulk annuity termination clauses
summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority plans in 2026 to revisit how bulk purchase annuity writers responded to its 2025 Dear CEO letter on solvency-triggered termination rights, part of a broader regulatory focus on the fast-growing pension risk transfer market.

headline: ICICI Prudential Life posts 28% profit jump and record margins in first quarter
summary: ICICI Prudential Life reported first-quarter profit after tax of roughly Rs 386 crore, up nearly 28% year over year, with value of new business climbing almost 25% and margins reaching a record 26.7% on stronger protection sales.

headline: PLANSPONSOR's 2026 recordkeeping survey finds service model shifting as plans expand beyond savings
summary: Recordkeepers face continued fee compression even as sponsors demand more technology, participant advice and financial wellness tools, with 403(b) plans in particular requiring specialized multi-vendor compliance support.

headline: Ascensus launches national nonprofit 403(b) pooled employer plan
summary: Ascensus rolled out a new 403(b) Pooled Employer Plan for nonprofit organizations, with Newport serving as pooled plan provider and administrative fiduciary and Aprio providing independent investment oversight.

headline: Target-date funds with guaranteed income features surge past $103 billion
summary: Assets in target-date products carrying guaranteed income options grew 25% to $103 billion by mid-2025, with BlackRock's LifePath Paycheck series nearly tripling to $24 billion and TIAA's RetirePlus reaching $60 billion.

headline: Catastrophe bond issuance hits record $18 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Second-quarter cat bond issuance alone topped $11.3 billion, pushing first-half volume to an all-time high as investor capital continues flooding into insurance-linked securities.

headline: Reinsurance property rates fall up to 25% at July renewals as capital base hits $790 billion
summary: Record capital inflows and a quieter 2025 hurricane season drove some of the steepest reinsurance property rate declines in decades at the July 1 renewal date, easing costs for primary insurers.

headline: Canadian ETF assets cross $100 billion mark earlier than ever in first half of 2026
summary: Canada's ETF industry reached $104 billion in year-to-date asset growth by the end of June, the earliest the market has ever crossed the $100 billion threshold in a given year.

headline: RIA consolidators expect deal valuations to flatten through second half of 2026
summary: A new survey finds 82% of RIA acquirers expect valuations to hold steady rather than climb further, with firms managing $1-5 billion in assets remaining the most sought-after acquisition targets.

headline: Agentic AI adoption accelerates among RIAs, though usage still trails wirehouses
summary: A recent survey found roughly a quarter of advisory firms have no agentic AI in use at all, while others already have agents in production, with adoption still far higher among captive wirehouse and bank advisors than independent RIAs.

headline: AI-native wealth manager Arca exits stealth with $64 million and Vanguard's former CEO on its board
summary: Founded by ex-Plaid product leader Rron Rexha, Arca raised a $15.5 million seed round and $48.5 million Series A led by General Catalyst, adding former Vanguard chief Bill McNabb and Altruist CEO Jason Wenk as advisors while managing over $1 billion in client assets.

headline: Morgan Stanley unifies wealth and institutional units under new RIA-focused offering
summary: Morgan Stanley repositioned services under an Integrated Firm for RIAs and Family Offices initiative, combining its investment management and institutional equities divisions to better compete for outside advisory relationships.

headline: Sun Life's SLC Management names insurance veteran Chris Wei to lead Asia wealth and capital markets push
summary: SLC Management, Sun Life's $309 billion asset management arm, appointed 24-year insurance industry veteran Chris Wei as President of Asia Wealth & Capital Markets, drawing on his prior leadership roles at Great Eastern, AIA and Allstate.

headline: APAC wealth management market projected to reach $41.8 trillion by 2031
summary: The Asia-Pacific wealth management market is forecast to grow from roughly $29.6 trillion in 2026 to $41.8 trillion by 2031, with India's HNW population expected to grow faster than any other major APAC market through 2030.

headline: Hanover Insurance names COO Richard Lavey as CEO-elect ahead of 2026 succession
summary: Hanover Insurance Group said CEO John Roche will retire December 31, 2026, with current COO Richard Lavey named CEO-elect as the P&C insurer plans a phased leadership transition through investor updates later this year.

headline: NFP acquires Cleveland retirement and benefits advisory firm Total Benefits Advisors
summary: Aon-owned broker NFP announced the acquisition of Total Benefits Advisors, a Cleveland, Ohio firm spanning retirement services, employee benefits and wealth management for business owners and high-net-worth clients.

headline: KKR joins Amwins-Dragoneer consortium bidding for Australia's Steadfast in A$7.7 billion buyout
summary: Global investment firm KKR joined the existing takeover consortium pursuing insurance broker network Steadfast Group, with the group's due diligence period extended by four weeks and the A$6-per-share offer unchanged.

headline: Sedgwick, Crawford and CorVel cement AI-led lead in $544.7 billion global TPA market
summary: A new market analysis frames insurance third-party administration as a $544.67 billion global industry increasingly dominated by AI-equipped incumbents Sedgwick, Crawford & Company and CorVel Corp.

headline: Sedgwick earns Great Place To Work certification for fifth consecutive year
summary: The claims and TPA giant said the certification is based entirely on feedback from current employees about their experience working at the company.

headline: FinTech Junction 2026 returns to Tel Aviv, drawing insurance, payments and AI leaders
summary: Israel's leading annual fintech conference brought together senior leaders from banking, insurance, cybersecurity, payments and the startup ecosystem for a day of programming aimed at enterprise decision-makers.

headline: Zywave launches Apex, an AI-native growth stack built for insurance distribution
summary: The insurance broker technology specialist introduced Zywave Apex, aimed at speeding up quoting, sharpening account intelligence and giving agencies clearer pipeline visibility across the front office.

headline: EZLynx partners with First Connect to extend all-in-one agency management system to member agents
summary: The partnership gives First Connect's network of independent agents discounted access to EZLynx's agency management platform, bundling automation and AI across policy management, accounting and marketing.

headline: Underwriting automation funding jumps more than twentyfold year-over-year
summary: Underwriting automation startups raised roughly $178 million across seven deals so far in 2026, up sharply from about $8 million across two deals in the same period last year, per a weekly investment tracker.

headline: Gyde raises $60 million as insurtech funding concentrates in a handful of AI-native mega-deals
summary: Newly launched insurance startup Gyde raised $60 million in funding, part of a broader 2026 pattern in which the top five insurtech deals have captured the large majority of all capital raised.

headline: UnitedHealth beats Q2 2026 estimates, raises full-year profit guidance
summary: UnitedHealth reported second-quarter revenue of $112 billion and adjusted earnings of $6.38 per share, raising full-year adjusted guidance to $19.50-$20.00 per share as its medical cost ratio improved from the prior year.

headline: Elevance Health raises full-year guidance after medical costs come in below expectations
summary: Elevance posted adjusted second-quarter EPS of $7.45, well above Wall Street estimates, and lifted its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $27.00 while targeting a return to 12% earnings growth in 2027.

headline: CMS opens comment period on PBM pay restrictions taking effect in 2028
summary: CMS is gathering feedback on how to define PBM affiliates and enforce flat, non-drug-price-linked bona fide service fee compensation limits taking effect in 2028 under the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, with comments due July 20.

headline: Senators press UnitedHealthcare, Humana and CVS Health over AI-driven prior authorization denials
summary: Sens. Richard Blumenthal and Josh Hawley sent letters demanding records on how each insurer's Medicare Advantage plans use algorithms in post-acute care coverage decisions, giving the companies until July 28 to respond.

headline: India's health insurers post record premium collections after GST exemption on individual policies
summary: General insurers collected roughly Rs 1.24 lakh crore in health insurance premiums over eleven months of the current fiscal year, the industry's highest-ever total, following September 2025's GST exemption on individual health policies.

headline: Mayo Clinic runs roughly 150 AI models in production, including a new tool to speed chart review
summary: Mayo Clinic clinicians are using a new AI tool that generates chronological patient summaries and makes searching medical records faster, part of a broader deployment of around 150 AI models across the hospital.

headline: Sutter Health and Allina Health sign definitive agreement to form $26 billion nonprofit system
summary: The two nonprofit health systems moved closer to combining operations across California, Minnesota and Wisconsin, with Allina becoming Sutter's Upper Midwest Division and the deal expected to close by year-end pending regulatory approval.

headline: Swiss Re Institute says life insurance will lead global premium growth as rates stay elevated
summary: Swiss Re Institute's latest sigma report forecasts global life insurance premiums growing 2.3% in real terms in 2026, above the long-term trend, as higher yields keep supporting savings and annuity sales while emerging markets benefit from favorable demographics.

headline: NAIC life committee weighs 2027 valuation manual changes and annuity disclosure overhaul
summary: The NAIC's Life Insurance and Annuities (A) Committee met on July 13 to consider adopting Life Actuarial Task Force amendments to the 2027 Valuation Manual and approving a project to revise the Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation.

headline: DOL urges Supreme Court to uphold dismissal of Intel 401(k) alternative-assets suit
summary: The Department of Labor filed an amicus brief backing a stricter pleading standard and asking the Supreme Court to affirm dismissal of a lawsuit accusing Intel of imprudently investing its 401(k) plan in non-traditional assets like private equity and hedge funds.

headline: EBSA's 2026 agenda lists roughly 20 pending retirement-plan rulemakings
summary: The Labor Department's Employee Benefits Security Administration released its 2026 regulatory agenda on July 3, outlining guidance projects at various stages including an investment-selection safe harbor, an ESG-replacement rule, and several SECURE 2.0 implementation items.

headline: Global commercial insurance rates turn negative for the first time in seven years
summary: Ahead of Q2 earnings, analysts point to the Marsh Global Insurance Market Index falling to roughly -4%, with the steepest declines in commercial property, workers' comp, cyber and D&O, even as US casualty and commercial auto keep hardening on social inflation and nuclear verdicts.

headline: AssuranceAmerica breach exposed 6.9 million driver's license records after 115-day notification delay
summary: Auto insurer AssuranceAmerica confirmed a breach traced to a compromised employee account in March that exposed names, driver's license numbers and policy details for roughly 6.9 million people, with notification letters only going out in mid-July.

headline: Gallagher's RPS buys wholesale broker Med James to extend specialty reach
summary: Arthur J. Gallagher's Risk Placement Services acquired Kansas-based wholesale broker and MGA Med James, adding transportation, environmental and cyber specialty lines across a six-state Mid-South and Mountain West footprint.

headline: MISSION-backed Amulet Specialty launches as a new property and casualty MGA
summary: Amulet Specialty, a new specialist MGA backed by MISSION and led by co-founders Paul Bennett and Jonathan Dermody, launched offering property, casualty, liability and business-interruption cover.

headline: Jensten Group expands into Scotland with Kelvin Smith Insurance acquisition
summary: UK broking group Jensten agreed to buy Glasgow-based Kelvin Smith Insurance, a broker founded in 1982 managing roughly £22 million of gross written premium, adding 30 staff and more than 3,000 clients as part of its Scottish expansion.

headline: Australian underwriting agency Blue Zebra renews multi-year QBE motor capacity deal
summary: Blue Zebra, an Australian MGA, extended its multi-year capacity agreement with QBE covering personal and commercial motor lines, alongside a strengthened specialist underwriting and claims team.

headline: One Inc and CalcFocus team up to modernize life insurance premium payments
summary: Payment platform One Inc partnered with policy administration provider CalcFocus to integrate One Inc's PremiumPay into life insurers' systems, giving policyholders more digital payment options including Apple Pay, Google Pay and Venmo.

headline: American Growth Insurance debuts as AI-enabled brokerage platform with roughly $70 million in backing
summary: American Growth Insurance launched as an AI-enabled specialty brokerage growth platform with nearly $70 million in committed equity funding from Rockbridge Growth Equity and venture studio Atomic.

headline: Vertafore adds new AI agent to automate MGA submission intake
summary: Vertafore introduced a Velocity AI Submission Processing Agent that reads emails, PDFs and spreadsheets to extract policy data for MGA workflows, reaching roughly 87% extraction accuracy in early trials and automatically flagging incomplete submissions.

headline: Malaysian insurtech PolicyStreet tops up Series C with $5 million impact investment
summary: PolicyStreet, a Malaysia-based digital insurance group operating across Asia and Australia, added $5 million to its Series C round from impact investor BlueOrchard's InsuResilience strategy, bringing the round total to $26 million.

headline: Insurance AI-agent startup Pace raises $46 million to scale back-office automation
summary: Pace, whose AI agents automate insurer back-office tasks like submission intake, policy servicing and claims handling, raised a $46 million Series B co-led by Thrive Capital and Sequoia Capital, after completing more than a quarter-million automated workflows for carriers including Prudential and WTW.

headline: Bristol NHS Foundation Trust launches as one of the UK's biggest health trusts after merger
summary: University Hospitals Bristol and Weston NHS Foundation Trust merged with a neighboring trust on July 1 to form the new Bristol NHS Foundation Trust, creating an organization with about 28,000 staff and roughly £2.6 billion in annual turnover.

headline: IRDAI signals commission-reform paper to curb insurance mis-selling
summary: India's insurance regulator is preparing a consultation paper, expected by end of July, that would spread agent and distributor commissions across a policy's full term instead of paying them upfront, mirroring practices in the US, UK and Europe.

headline: Guaranteed lifetime income tied to longer lifespans, NBER study finds
summary: New National Bureau of Economic Research analysis found retirees who convert savings into annuity income are about 3% less likely to die over the following decade than those who manage withdrawals on their own.

headline: Fidelity to add guaranteed income to target-date lineup via new CIT suite
summary: Fidelity partnered with Nationwide and New York Life to build "Fidelity Freedom Lifetime," a target-date collective investment trust suite with an embedded guaranteed-income option, set to reach employers on Fidelity's recordkeeping platform in early 2027.

headline: EIOPA locks in new proportionality framework under revised Solvency II
summary: Europe's insurance regulator held an event marking the new proportionality framework under the revised Solvency II Directive, part of a broader rules package covering liquidity risk, group solvency and disclosure due to apply from January 2027.

headline: Aon: APAC transaction-risk insurance claims grow more severe and complex
summary: Aon's 2026 Global Transaction Solutions Claims Study found Asia-Pacific M&A insurance claims increasingly involve high-severity, cross-border losses exceeding $10 million, with capacity and adoption expanding in India, Singapore and Korea.

headline: Vestmark's outsourced RIA platform grows fivefold to $50 billion
summary: Vestmark Advisory Services' assets under management jumped from $10 billion to $50 billion in 18 months, helped by referral ties with BlackRock, T. Rowe Price and Capital Group and the launch of an AI portfolio-monitoring tool called Vestmark Pulse.

headline: Most RIAs expect Washington to ease investor-protection rules in 2026
summary: A survey found 80% of registered investment advisors anticipate a major relaxation of consumer-protection enforcement in 2026, nearly double the 45% of broker-dealer advisors who expect the same shift.

headline: Asia-Pacific non-life premium growth seen cooling to 2.5% in 2026
summary: Non-life insurance premium growth across Asia-Pacific is forecast to slow to 2.5% in 2026 from 2.9% in 2024, while life premium growth is expected to improve to 1.1% after a negative 2024.

headline: MSIG Asia names Ronak Shah as regional chief executive
summary: MSIG Asia appointed insurance veteran Ronak Shah, most recently CEO of QBE's Wholesale Markets Asia business, as regional CEO effective October 1, succeeding Clemens Philippi.

headline: CRC Group recruits Beazley's Bethany Greenwood to lead underwriting arm
summary: Wholesale broker CRC Group named Bethany Greenwood, formerly head of specialty risks at Beazley in London, as CEO of its underwriting division spanning Starwind Specialty, AmRisc, Atrium and Euclid Transactional.

headline: Aon hires WTW's Sean Deehan to lead APAC strategy and technology
summary: Aon appointed Sean Deehan, formerly WTW's Greater China divisional leader, as CEO of its Strategy and Technology Group for Asia-Pacific, tasked with expanding adoption of Aon's PathWise life-and-annuity risk modeling platform across the region.

headline: New federal law forces PBMs and TPAs to open their books on fees
summary: Provisions in the 2026 Consolidated Appropriations Act require pharmacy benefit managers and third-party administrators to disclose, at the claim level, the gap between what health plans pay them and what they reimburse pharmacies.

headline: DOL disclosure proposal would apply to TPAs contracting with self-funded plans
summary: A Department of Labor proposal issued January 30 would require PBMs and third-party administrators to give employer-sponsored, self-funded ERISA health plans extensive advance fee and compensation disclosures before contracting, with proposed applicability starting July 1, 2026.

headline: Compliance-AI startup Norm AI hits unicorn status with $120 million round
summary: Norm AI, which embeds regulatory and legal reasoning into AI agents for regulated enterprises, raised a $120 million Series C at a $1.2 billion valuation led by Khosla Ventures, with Vanguard, New York Life and TIAA also participating.

headline: SME lender Forward Financing lands $525 million funding package
summary: Forward Financing secured $525 million to expand small-business lending capacity, part of a broader week of heavy fintech fundraising that also touched insurance- and wealth-adjacent platforms.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures unveils 2026 accelerator class of nine startups
summary: BrokerTech Ventures named its 2026 accelerator cohort of nine insurtech startups and confirmed dates for its second annual BrokerTech Connect conference, set for September 1-2 in Chicago.

headline: Medicare Advantage penetration holds at 55% as UnitedHealth, Humana dominate
summary: More than half of eligible Medicare beneficiaries are now enrolled in Medicare Advantage, with UnitedHealth Group and Humana together accounting for 46% of all MA enrollees, while special-needs-plan offerings keep expanding.

headline: Centene opens buyout window for most of its 61,000 employees
summary: Centene is offering voluntary separation packages to the bulk of its workforce after enrollment fell sharply, particularly in its ACA marketplace business, which dropped from 5.6 million to 3.6 million members, with layoffs possible if too few volunteer.

headline: Nearly 5 million could lose coverage as enhanced ACA subsidies lapse
summary: With enhanced ACA premium tax credits expired and congressional extension stalled, the Urban Institute projects roughly 4.8 million people will become uninsured in 2026 as marketplace premiums rise sharply for many enrollees.

headline: Viz.ai expands into neurodegenerative disease with Cortechs.ai tie-up
summary: Viz.ai will integrate Cortechs.ai's quantitative neuroimaging tools into its care-coordination platform, starting with multiple sclerosis, giving hospitals in its roughly 2,000-site US network faster ways to identify and manage MS patients.

headline: NYU Langone builds AI tool to flag patients needing care after discharge
summary: NYU Langone embedded a discharge-prediction tool directly into its Epic EHR system to flag internal-medicine patients likely to need continued care after leaving the hospital, with plans to expand it using emergency-department and therapy notes.

headline: NHS launches £85 million AI-driven obesity care pilots
summary: NHS England, backed by £50 million in government funding and £35 million from Eli Lilly, is rolling out 12 projects including AI-assisted triage in Norfolk and Suffolk and 24/7 WhatsApp coaching for families in Kent, aiming to ease pressure on specialist obesity clinics.

headline: Resolution Re books another UK pension risk transfer deal as European push continues
summary: Resolution Life's Bermuda-based reinsurer Resolution Re completed a fresh funded-reinsurance transaction backing a UK pension risk transfer deal, extending the group's expansion into Europe's bulk annuity market.

headline: North American life insurers show resilient earnings despite market turbulence, Morningstar DBRS finds
summary: Morningstar DBRS reports average adjusted earnings rose 10% quarter-over-quarter among the ten largest non-mutual North American life insurers, including MetLife, Prudential and Manulife, pointing to steady capital strength heading into the second half of 2026.

headline: RCH pitches centralized clearinghouse to fix 401(k) plan data portability
summary: Retirement Clearinghouse proposed a system-level intervention aimed at solving the data and asset-portability problems that have long plagued the 401(k) recordkeeping industry, as participants change jobs and providers.

headline: DC recordkeeping assets keep concentrating even as $600 billion in annual outflows cap growth
summary: Morningstar data shows defined contribution recordkeeping assets have jumped since 2020 and collective investment trusts keep gaining share, but roughly $600 billion a year in outflows to rollovers and withdrawals is capping overall system growth.

headline: Hanwha Asset Management tilts H2 target-date strategy toward AI winners while urging diversification
summary: Hanwha Asset Management unveiled a second-half target-date fund strategy that raises exposure to companies benefiting from expanded AI investment, while cautioning Korean retirement savers to keep portfolios diversified.

headline: KB Asset Management launches Korea-focused qualified target-date fund
summary: KB Asset Management rolled out a new domestically focused target-date fund for Korean retirement pension accounts, concentrating holdings in local stocks and bonds rather than global benchmarks.

headline: Hightower agrees to acquire $9.5 billion RIA The Bahnsen Group
summary: Hightower signed a deal to acquire The Bahnsen Group, a 12-office RIA overseeing roughly $9.5 billion in assets across 10 states, in a transaction expected to close in the third quarter of 2026 as consolidation among independent advisory firms continues.

headline: P&C insurers expand vendor technology stacks, latest carrier roundup shows
summary: PropertyCasualty360's latest 'who's using what' roundup tracks new technology vendor selections across property and casualty carriers, with Duck Creek Technologies featured among the most active platform providers this month.

headline: Insurance sector logs another wave of senior appointments and job moves
summary: Insurance-Edge's weekly roundup of leadership changes across brokers, carriers and MGAs highlights fresh executive appointments moving through the UK and European insurance market this week.

headline: Reliance Global Group launches in-house AI agent for insurance back-office automation
summary: Nasdaq-listed Reliance Global Group unveiled a proprietary AI agent that automates browser-based back-office tasks like endorsements, quote pulls and status checks for its network of insurance agencies, built with a compliance-focused security framework.

headline: American Growth Insurance launches with $70 million to build AI-native brokerage platform
summary: Atlanta-based American Growth Insurance debuted as an AI-enabled specialty brokerage growth platform backed by Rockbridge Growth Equity and Atomic, saying its AI-first operating model lifted average partner-agency profitability by more than 50%.

headline: Cover Genius raises $100 million at $1.9 billion valuation to scale embedded protection
summary: Embedded-insurance platform Cover Genius secured $100 million from Vista Credit Partners, pushing its valuation to $1.9 billion as it invests in AI-driven hyper-personalization and expands into new verticals.

headline: InsurTech funding concentrates in fewer, larger deals as underwriting automation gains favor
summary: Year-to-date 2026 InsurTech equity funding reached $2.85 billion, down from 2025's pace, with underwriting-automation startups pulling in far more capital while claims-automation and usage-based insurance rounds nearly dried up.

headline: NYU Langone deploys real-time AI alerts in the emergency department to catch high-risk diagnoses
summary: NYU Langone's emergency department is running models that watch documentation, lab results and imaging in real time, surfacing alerts when patterns suggest a high-risk diagnosis may be worth revisiting to counter anchoring bias.

headline: Sanford Health and Marshfield Clinic complete $10 billion Midwest hospital merger
summary: Sanford Health and Marshfield Clinic Health System finished their merger less than six months after announcing it, forming a $10 billion nonprofit system spanning 56 hospitals, 4,500 providers and nearly 56,000 employees across the rural Midwest.

headline: Hospital operating margins slip to 2.6% in July as costs keep outpacing revenue
summary: National hospital operating margins fell to 2.6% on average in July, down from 3.4% in June, with rising workforce, supply and drug costs continuing to squeeze profitability even as bad debt and charity care climb.

headline: Fixed annuity rates climb toward 7% as carriers compete for retirement savers
summary: Top fixed annuity rates reached as high as 6.80% on seven-year terms in late July, with Knighthead Life among carriers offering the most competitive guaranteed rates to income-seeking retirees.

headline: Life insurers head into 2026 on strong capital footing as annuity demand holds
summary: Coverage of the life and annuity sector highlights resilient client demand for annuities and reassurance messaging aimed at advisors as carriers navigate market volatility through 2026.

headline: DC plan sponsors show rising appetite for alternative investments but need lineup guidance
summary: A NAPA-Net report finds 44% of defined contribution plan sponsors are interested in adding alternative investments to 401(k) lineups, with large and mega plans showing the strongest enthusiasm at 62% and 50% respectively.

headline: Fidelity to launch target-date funds with built-in guaranteed income, backed by Nationwide
summary: Fidelity announced Freedom Lifetime, a target-date collective investment trust suite adding a guaranteed lifetime income option for plan sponsors, with Nationwide serving as the insurance partner starting in early 2027.

headline: Target-date fund assets swell to $4.8 trillion, still concentrated among five firms
summary: The target-date fund industry grew 20.3% in 2025 to reach $4.8 trillion, with Vanguard alone holding roughly 37% of assets even as the broader industry keeps compounding at double-digit rates.

headline: Asia-Pacific insurers split on private-markets push as bond yields soften
summary: S&P Global Ratings finds APAC insurers face a strategic choice on how aggressively to expand into private markets as fixed-income yields soften, regulatory capital reform proceeds, and macro instability persists.

headline: AllocateRite's model-to-proposal wealthtech platform goes live across RIA firms nationwide
summary: AllocateRite announced its portfolio-modeling and proposal platform is now live across multiple RIA firms, replacing fragmented manual workflows with a single system spanning model construction through client-ready proposals.

headline: Creative Planning buys Lovell Insurance Group to build out commercial insurance arm
summary: RIA giant Creative Planning, with roughly $710 billion in assets under management and advisement, acquired Kansas City-area commercial insurance brokerage Lovell Insurance Group to broaden its risk-management and business-advisory services.

headline: Sanctuary Wealth adds $5.9 billion in new assets in H1 2026, lifting total client assets to $65.7 billion
summary: Hybrid RIA platform Sanctuary Wealth grew total client assets to $65.7 billion, more than doubling since 2023, as advisor teams continued seeking flexible affiliation models away from wirehouses.

headline: SEC signals wave of rule revamps ahead for registered investment advisers
summary: Coverage of the SEC's 2026 regulatory agenda points to upcoming rule changes affecting investment advisers, following a June risk alert that flagged undisclosed revenue-sharing practices in advisor cash-sweep programs.

headline: US P&C insurers post best underwriting result in a decade in 2025
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry recorded a combined ratio of 93 in 2025, its best in ten years, as direct premiums written grew 5% to roughly $1.11 trillion, though not every line shared in the improvement.

headline: Federato report finds 64-point gap between P&C leadership and underwriters on real-time risk visibility
summary: Federato's 2026 State of P&C Insurance Technology report found 91% of P&C leaders believe they have real-time portfolio control, but only 27% of underwriters agree, with fully AI-integrated insurers 3.6 times more likely to actually have that visibility.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance Group for $1.54 billion, creating a New England auto leader
summary: Safety Insurance Group agreed to an all-cash $1.54 billion acquisition by a Mapfre affiliate at $105 per share, a deal expected to create the second-largest private passenger auto insurer in New England.

headline: Mid-July hailstorms across France and Germany push European insured losses toward a billion euros
summary: A sequence of severe convective storms across Europe from July 10-17 drove hail, wind and flash-flood damage concentrated in France and Germany, with Aon estimating aggregate losses of at least hundreds of millions of euros and potential to reach a billion-euro industry event.

headline: Severe convective storms overtake hurricanes as costliest US insured weather peril
summary: Aon's 2026 Climate and Catastrophe Insight report finds severe convective storms have driven $50 billion in insured losses over two years, displacing hurricanes as the leading source of US insured weather losses, especially in suburban housing markets.

headline: Global MGA market on pace to more than double to $128.7 billion by 2034
summary: A market research report values the global managing general agent segment at $63.4 billion in 2025 and projects an 8.2% compound annual growth rate through 2034 as carriers keep delegating underwriting authority to MGAs.

headline: Insurance people moves: AIPSO names new CEO, Canopius taps HSBC exec as group COO
summary: Les Willis was named president and CEO of AIPSO succeeding a retiring 32-year veteran, while Canopius appointed an HSBC executive as group COO among a wave of other senior insurance leadership changes reported this week.

headline: TPA Marpai projects positive cash flow after adding 192,000 new member lives
summary: Marpai said new client wins across its third-party administration and MarpaiRx pharmacy benefit management platforms are expected to add roughly 192,000 member lives, with the company projecting positive cash flow and EBITDA starting in August 2026.

headline: AI-driven insurtech Corgi's valuation soars to $4 billion in third raise within three months
summary: San Francisco-based AI insurtech Corgi secured fresh capital at a $4 billion valuation, nearly double its late-May mark, marking its third fundraise in under three months amid intense investor demand for AI-native insurance platforms.

headline: Y Combinator-backed Klaimee raises $5.5 million seed to insure autonomous AI agents
summary: Klaimee secured $5.5 million in seed funding to build insurance-backed performance warranties for autonomous AI agents, a new coverage category emerging as enterprises deploy agentic AI at scale.

headline: Howden names new Japan natural-resources head and Australia aviation partner
summary: Howden appointed Junichiro Ito as head of natural resources for Japan and Elizabeth Antoine as a partner for aviation in Australia, part of a broader wave of APAC insurance broking leadership moves this week.

headline: Four in ten insurers now use AI in underwriting as straight-through processing rates jump
summary: A new industry report finds 40% of insurers are leveraging AI within underwriting, with timelines collapsing from three days to three minutes in some workflows, straight-through processing rising from 10-15% to 70-90%, and fraud detection improving over 30%.

headline: IRDAI chief pushes to eliminate 'dark patterns' from insurance apps and websites
summary: IRDAI Chairperson Ajay Seth called for eliminating deceptive digital design practices, or 'dark patterns,' from insurers' apps and websites, framing consumer-trust protections as essential to expanding digital insurance access.

headline: Abarca-LucyRx merger creates new PBM serving 9 million members, may spur more deals
summary: The combination of pharmacy benefit managers Abarca Health and LucyRx formed a new alternative PBM serving more than nine million members, with analysts expecting the tie-up to spur further consolidation among smaller PBMs facing rising regulatory complexity.

headline: Prudential-HCL joint venture becomes India's eighth standalone health insurer
summary: IRDAI granted a certificate of registration to Prudential HCL Health Insurance, a joint venture 70%-owned by Prudential plc and 30%-owned by HCL Group's Vama Sundari Investments, making it India's eighth standalone health insurer.

headline: Hospital executives urged to own AI governance and accountability
summary: A STAT News analysis argues hospital executives, not just IT departments, must take direct accountability for clinical AI governance, warning that oversight gaps determine whether AI strengthens or undermines patient and clinician trust.

headline: Indexed annuity trade group pushes back on proposed illustration rule changes
summary: The Indexed Annuity Leadership Council submitted comments to the NAIC's Life Insurance and Annuities Illustrations working group opposing parts of a proposed overhaul of Model #245, the annuity disclosure regulation, ahead of further working-group review.

headline: Life insurers head into second half of 2026 favoring quiet block and reinsurance deals over big mergers
summary: Industry analysts expect life and annuity M&A to stay measured through the rest of 2026, with closed-block transactions, reinsurance arrangements and distribution-driven deals dominating rather than large-scale carrier mergers.

headline: India's EPFO formally launches overhauled EPF, pension and insurance schemes for 2026
summary: EPFO rolled out its restructured EPF, EPS and EDLI schemes for 2026 effective July 1, keeping contribution rates unchanged while crediting 8.25% interest on provident fund balances and raising the auto-settlement claims limit to ₹5 lakh.

headline: M&G completes £760 million bulk annuity deal, closing out UK pension scheme's buy-in program
summary: M&G finalized a £760 million bulk purchase annuity with the Smiths Industries Pension Scheme covering more than 10,000 members, the scheme's fifth and final buy-in as UK insurers keep absorbing defined-benefit pension risk.

headline: US pension risk transfer deals grow in number but shrink in size as funding surpluses persist
summary: LIMRA data shows the first half of 2026 was marked by a rising count of smaller defined-benefit buy-in transactions even as total US pension risk transfer deal volume edged lower, with insurers still expecting strong appetite for the rest of the year.

headline: P&C insurers' book yields hit decade high in 2025 even as income growth cools
summary: Property-casualty insurers' portfolio book yield climbed to a ten-year high of 4.39% in 2025, though net investment income as a share of invested assets slipped modestly from its 2024 peak as reinvestment rates began to normalize.

headline: Global insurer invested assets climb to $9.6 trillion as insurers keep pivoting toward private markets
summary: A Goldman Sachs Asset Management survey finds US insurers' cash and invested assets grew 6.7% year-over-year to $9.6 trillion at the end of 2025, with respondents expecting continued rotation into private credit and asset-backed finance for incremental yield.

headline: Wealth Enhancement expands Houston footprint with $299 million Trippon acquisition
summary: Wealth Enhancement closed its purchase of Trippon Wealth Management Group and its affiliated CPA practice, adding roughly $299 million in client assets and pushing the RIA aggregator past $158 billion in total client assets.

headline: Wealth fintech Arca emerges from stealth with $64 million to build AI-powered advisory platform
summary: Arca, founded by a former Plaid product lead, raised a combined $64 million seed and Series A round led by Venrock and General Catalyst to build AI agents meant to support human financial advisors across planning, tax and estate work.

headline: US wealthtech deal count jumps 27% in Q2 2026 even as total funding declines
summary: US wealthtech recorded 116 deals in the second quarter of 2026, up 27% year-over-year, even though total funding fell 41% to $557.8 million as investors favored more, smaller rounds over mega-deals.

headline: Property reinsurance rates fall as much as 25% at July renewals on record capital
summary: Abundant reinsurance capital pushed property catastrophe rates down as much as 25% at the July 1 renewal, with Guy Carpenter's global property rate-on-line index posting its steepest annual decline since the late 1990s.

headline: US commercial insurance buyers see relief in property and cyber, but casualty costs keep climbing
summary: Alliant's midyear market report finds US commercial buyers getting rate relief in property and cyber lines, while casualty and transportation risks remain pressured by litigation costs and rising claims severity.

headline: KKR joins consortium's A$7.7 billion bid to take Australian broker Steadfast private
summary: KKR joined Amwins Group and Dragoneer Investment Group's non-binding proposal to acquire Australian insurance broker Steadfast Group for roughly A$7.7 billion, with KKR and Dragoneer set to control the retail brokerage business and Amwins taking the underwriting agency operations.

headline: Excess and surplus lines property rate softening accelerates as casualty increases slow
summary: CRC Group's REDY report shows property rate softening picking up pace in the excess and surplus market even as the rate of casualty rate increases begins to decelerate, reflecting the broader bifurcation in the US commercial market.

headline: American Growth Insurance raises $70 million to acquire and rebuild US brokerages with AI
summary: Tech-forward brokerage growth platform American Growth Insurance raised $70 million in committed equity led by Atomic and Rockbridge Growth Equity, aiming to close several more independent agency acquisitions and rebuild their operations around AI agents.

headline: PIB Group names Alastair Hay as chief financial officer
summary: UK-based insurance intermediary PIB Group appointed Alastair Hay as its new chief financial officer effective immediately, part of a wave of senior leadership moves across European brokers and MGAs in mid-July.

headline: Insurance TPA and claims-services businesses fetch 4x-8x EBITDA in 2026 deal market
summary: A new valuation analysis finds founder-led insurance third-party administrator and claims-services firms transacting between 4x and 8x EBITDA in 2026, with revenue type, client concentration and workforce structure driving where deals land in that range.

headline: Fulcrum raises $25 million to scale AI automation across US insurance brokers
summary: Fulcrum raised $25 million in seed and Series A funding led by CRV to expand its AI platform for insurance brokers, which automates proposal creation, policy checks and coverage comparisons and has cut policy delivery timelines from 15 days to same-day.

headline: PropTech firm Foxen embeds Healthy Paws pet insurance into its renter platform
summary: Foxen partnered with pet insurer Healthy Paws to embed discounted pet coverage directly into its PetClear renter platform, giving qualifying residents a 5% savings on new policies as embedded insurance keeps expanding beyond core financial products.

headline: Vertafore rolls out new AI agents to automate carrier statement reconciliation for agencies
summary: Vertafore released two new Velocity AI agents inside its AgencyOne platform that automate carrier statement reconciliation and turn Outlook email activity into structured workflows, aiming to cut manual work for independent insurance agencies.

headline: Fulcrum taps veteran brokerage operations executive to drive AI workflow push
summary: Broker-facing AI automation platform Fulcrum brought on a brokerage operations veteran to lead its push into deeper AI workflow adoption, following the company's recent $25 million funding round.

headline: Cover Genius raises $100 million credit facility at $1.9 billion valuation
summary: Embedded insurance platform Cover Genius closed a $100 million credit raise backed by Vista Credit Partners at a $1.9 billion valuation, a sign that embedded insurance financing has matured beyond traditional venture capital rounds.

headline: UnitedHealth Group's Q2 profit hits $5.4 billion as medical costs ease
summary: UnitedHealth Group reported second-quarter net income of $5.48 billion and raised its 2026 earnings forecast after its medical care ratio fell to 86.7% from 89.4% a year earlier, aided by benefit redesign and exits from unprofitable ACA and Medicare Advantage markets.

headline: FTC secures Caremark settlement locking in up to $8.5 billion in consumer drug savings
summary: The Federal Trade Commission reached a settlement with Caremark Rx and Zinc Health Services resolving claims that the PBM used anticompetitive rebate schemes to inflate insulin prices, requiring rebate pass-through at the point of sale and estimated to save consumers up to $8.5 billion over a decade.

headline: Health insurers propose median 14% premium increases across ACA exchanges for 2027
summary: Insurers in 16 states and Washington, D.C. have proposed a median 14% premium increase for next year's ACA exchange plans, citing rising healthcare costs and the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal subsidies.

headline: Sutter Health and Allina Health sign definitive deal to form $26 billion nonprofit system
summary: Sacramento-based Sutter Health signed a definitive agreement to acquire Minneapolis-based Allina Health, creating a combined 39-hospital, $26 billion nonprofit system spanning California, Minnesota and Wisconsin, with Sutter committing $2 billion to Allina's home markets.

headline: Clinical-grade AI moves from data center to point of care as governance infrastructure catches up
summary: A July 2026 digital health roundup finds clinical AI increasingly deployed at the point of care through surgical robots and wearables, with health system leaders emphasizing that strong oversight and clinician accountability determine whether AI strengthens or undermines patient trust.

headline: North American Risk Services Names New Workers' Comp Chief
summary: Claims and TPA firm North American Risk Services has appointed industry veteran Alice Wells to head its workers' compensation division, tasking her with overseeing claims strategy and operations nationwide.

headline: Global Insurance Premium Growth Cools to 1.3% for 2026 Amid Market Fragmentation
summary: New industry analysis shows worldwide insurance premium growth decelerating sharply in 2026 as economic fragmentation and softer pricing weigh on both life and non-life segments, even as the total premium pool keeps expanding.

headline: Duck Creek Buys AI Underwriting Startup Send to Build Agentic Insurance Platform
summary: Duck Creek Technologies has acquired Send Technology Solutions, combining Duck Creek's core systems with Send's AI-native underwriting engine to create what it describes as the industry's first fully agentic policy lifecycle platform.

headline: American Growth Insurance Launches With $70 Million to Roll Up and AI-Enable Brokerages
summary: Backed by Rockbridge Growth Equity and venture studio Atomic, new platform American Growth Insurance has raised close to $70 million in committed equity to acquire independent agencies and convert them into AI-native operations.

headline: EU AI Act Now Classifies Insurance Underwriting as High-Risk, Forcing New Compliance Burden
summary: As of May 2026, the EU AI Act formally treats automated insurance underwriting as a high-risk AI use case, requiring insurers and insurtechs to maintain detailed documentation and conduct bias testing on their algorithms.

headline: APAC Insurtech Funding Roughly Halves as Investors Pull Back
summary: Insurtech investment across Asia-Pacific fell to about $4.1 billion for the 2022-2025 period, down sharply from roughly $9.1 billion raised between 2018 and 2021, reflecting a broader pullback in venture funding for the region's insurance startups.

headline: UK Insurtech Investment Hits £4.2 Billion as London Market Shows Resilience
summary: UK-focused insurtech investment reportedly reached a record £4.2 billion in 2026, with Series B funding rounds up 12% year-on-year, underscoring London's continued pull as a hub for insurance technology capital.

headline: ACA marketplace insurers push through steepest rate hikes in years as subsidy cliff looms
summary: Insurers are filing average marketplace premium increases near 26% for the coming plan year, the sharpest jump since 2018, largely because carriers are pricing in the scheduled expiration of enhanced federal premium tax credits and anticipate healthier members exiting the risk pool.

headline: Medicare Advantage plan menu shrinks even as enrollment keeps climbing
summary: A KFF analysis updated for July shows Medicare Advantage now covers 55% of eligible beneficiaries even though the number of available plans nationwide fell about 9% year over year, while federal per-person payments to plans rose roughly 14%, adding tens of billions in program spending.

headline: Smaller Indian cities overtake metros as the growth engine for high-value health cover
summary: Distribution data shows Tier-3 cities now account for over 41% of unlimited sum-insured health policy purchases in the current fiscal year, surpassing Tier-1 metros whose share has fallen sharply from roughly half of such sales two years ago, signaling a demand shift toward smaller-city buyers.

headline: Former Humana and CVS chief executives lend their names to an AI health insurance upstart
summary: Ex-CEOs of Humana and CVS Health have signed on as advisors to Optura, an AI-focused healthcare startup, with UnitedHealth Group also joining the advisory effort, underscoring how veteran payer leadership is migrating toward AI-native ventures.

headline: NHS speeds up AI deployment to cut waiting times across England
summary: NHS England is accelerating a broader rollout of AI tools, including a new AI triage feature in the NHS App to route patients to appropriate care and AI notetaking tools meant to cut administrative burden on staff, as part of efforts to shrink waiting lists.

headline: CMS moves to overhaul how Medicare reimburses clinical AI and remote monitoring
summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services is proposing significant changes to payment models for clinical AI tools and remote patient monitoring, a shift that could reshape how health systems justify and scale AI investments going forward.

headline: Digital health venture funding rebounds to $7.4 billion in first half of 2026
summary: Rock Health's mid-year tally shows digital health startups raised $7.4 billion across 244 deals in the first half of 2026, up from $6.4 billion a year earlier, with just 19 companies capturing 20 mega-rounds of $100 million or more that made up nearly half of all capital deployed.

headline: Malibu Life buys TruSpire to build a US retail annuity origination arm
summary: Malibu Life Holdings acquired TruSpire as part of a push to move beyond reinsurance and establish a direct annuity origination platform in the US market.

headline: Malibu Life installs ex-Prudential retirement chief as new CEO
summary: Malibu Life named Todd Shriber, formerly Prudential Financial's COO for global retirement and insurance, as CEO effective July 20, 2026, succeeding Gary Dombowsky as the firm expands into annuities and retirement distribution.

headline: UK pensions regulator finalizes CDC rules while pressing schemes on dashboard readiness
summary: The Pensions Regulator's updated code supporting multi-employer collective defined contribution schemes takes effect July 31, 2026, alongside continued enforcement pressure on trustees to prepare data ahead of the October 31 pensions dashboards connection deadline.

headline: Australia's superannuation overhaul takes effect, raising caps and taxing large balances
summary: From July 1, 2026, Australia's concessional super contribution cap rose to A$32,500 and a new Division 296 tax began applying extra levies of 15-25% on earnings tied to balances above A$3 million, reshaping retirement savings strategy.

headline: 401(k) recordkeepers lean into AI modernization as a fight over participant data looms
summary: Facing fee pressure, retirement recordkeepers are investing in AI-driven automation and faster processing to improve participant service, even as the industry heads toward disputes over who can access and monetize participant data.

headline: UK and EU regulators sharpen valuation and NAV-reporting expectations for private-market funds
summary: A July 2026 regulatory update highlights growing scrutiny of valuation processes for private-market exposures in retail-oriented investment products, as investor demand for timelier NAV reporting increases across UK and EU asset managers.

headline: RIA Roll-Up Wave Keeps Accelerating as National Platforms Snap Up Regional Advisory Shops
summary: National wealth platforms including Wealth Enhancement, Hightower and Aspen Standard Wealth continued a summer buying spree, absorbing firms such as an 88-year-old New York advisory practice and adding billions of dollars in combined client assets.

headline: AI-Native Wealth Startup Arca Exits Stealth With $64 Million and Vanguard's Former CEO Advising
summary: Arca, founded by a former Plaid product executive, raised $64 million across seed and Series A rounds led by Venrock and General Catalyst, and brought on ex-Vanguard chief Bill McNabb as it builds an AI-assisted advisory platform already overseeing more than $1 billion in client assets.

headline: UK Regulator Debuts Annual Insurance Priorities Report, Pledges to Simplify Rules While Guarding Consumers
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority issued its first annual regulatory priorities report for insurers, consolidating prior guidance and emphasizing protection of vulnerable consumers, better claims handling, and a push to cut regulatory complexity while still supporting sector growth and innovation.

headline: Specialty Insurer Canopius Poaches BCG Partner to Run Its US Business
summary: Canopius Group named Nadine Moore, a former senior partner at Boston Consulting Group, as CEO of its US operations starting in September, succeeding Lisa Davis as the London-based specialty carrier pushes to scale its American retail and wholesale business.

headline: India's Insurance Regulator Ties Top Executives' Pay Directly to Claims Service Quality
summary: IRDAI issued new norms requiring insurers to link half of senior executives' performance evaluation to customer-facing metrics such as claim settlement speed, grievance redressal and elimination of deceptive sales practices, with disclosure of claim closure and repudiation rates starting FY2026-27.

headline: ANV Group Buys Broker Iris to Broaden Its UK Distribution and MGA Reach
summary: ANV Group acquired UK insurance broker Iris in a move designed to expand its distribution footprint and strengthen its managing general agent platform in the British market.

headline: AI-Driven Pay-Per-Mile MGA Buys Up Legacy Agency as Carriers Scrutinize Distribution Ties
summary: Mile Auto, an AI-powered managing general agency, acquired Insurance House effective July 1, creating a combined operation with close to $100 million in annual premium, over 55,000 policyholders and roughly 1,600 independent agency relationships across ten states.

headline: UK Brokers Face Bigger-Than-Average Bill Hike to Fund Financial Regulator
summary: The FCA confirmed that insurance brokers' contribution to funding the regulator will rise faster than the watchdog's overall budget increase for 2026/27, following a consultation on fees and levies that drew industry pushback.

headline: India's insurance regulator weighs tying agent payouts to how long policies stay in force
summary: IRDAI is reportedly exploring rules that would connect distributor commissions to policyholder persistency, an effort meant to discourage churn-driven sales and cut down on early policy lapses.

headline: 401(k) balances hit new highs as pooled employer plans surge in popularity
summary: Average 401(k) account balances rose roughly 13% in 2025 on strong markets, while adoption of pooled employer plans jumped nearly 45% year-over-year, with most recordkeepers now supporting or planning to support PEPs.

headline: John Hancock rolls out an AI-enabled recordkeeping platform built on FIS technology
summary: John Hancock's new Future Choice platform runs on FIS Omni alongside other technology partners, intended to support a broader range of plan types, including pooled employer plans, while embedding AI and API-driven data capabilities.

headline: UK trustees navigate a wave of new pension rules taking effect this summer
summary: Following Royal Assent of the Pension Schemes Act 2026, UK trustees and schemes are now implementing a value-for-money framework for defined contribution schemes, small pot consolidation rules, and new collective defined contribution transfer regulations coming into force in late July.

headline: Harrison Street folds its European arm into RoundShield, creating a rebranded platform
summary: Harrison Street Asset Management announced it is integrating its European investment operations into RoundShield Partners, with the combined business rebranding as HSAM Europe, a year after Harrison Street first took a majority stake in RoundShield.

headline: Insurers keep piling into private credit even as market volatility raises eyebrows
summary: Insurers globally continue to expand private credit holdings in pursuit of higher yields and diversification, with the median allocation across insurer types now around 9%, up sharply from 2018, and roughly six in ten insurers planning further increases over the next two years.

headline: Wealth Enhancement grows its Houston presence with a tax-focused practice acquisition
summary: RIA aggregator Wealth Enhancement acquired Trippon, a roughly $299 million integrated tax-and-wealth planning practice, deepening its Houston footprint as part of its ongoing acquisition strategy centered on combined financial and tax services.

headline: Startup Carpe debuts a bundled AI intelligence suite aimed at property-casualty claims teams
summary: Carpe launched Carpe Claims, combining case management, computer-vision damage assessment and adjuster oversight tools into one suite, and says its technology is already live at most of the ten largest US P&C carriers.

headline: Florida regulators weigh stricter exam and disclosure requirements for property insurers
summary: Florida's insurance department scheduled a hearing on proposed rule changes that would tighten market conduct examinations and reporting obligations for property insurers operating in the state.

headline: Insurance distribution dealmaking slows to its weakest quarterly pace in a decade
summary: Global insurance brokerage and agency M&A volume fell to its lowest first-quarter tally since 2016, though analysts note the three-year decline appears to be leveling off as buyers shift toward smaller tuck-in deals.

headline: Workers'-comp claims administrator ESIS accused of blowing past mandated bill-response deadlines
summary: A billing-compliance watchdog reported that TPA ESIS repeatedly failed to respond to electronic medical bills within legally required timeframes for an injured worker's claim, renewing scrutiny of TPA compliance with state reporting rules.

headline: Embedded-insurance platform Cover Genius lands $100M credit round, nears $2B valuation
summary: Cover Genius secured a $100 million growth investment from Vista Credit Partners at a $1.9 billion valuation, its first credit-structured raise, to expand AI capabilities and pursue acquisitions across its point-of-sale insurance network.

headline: Jensten Group deepens Scottish footprint by snapping up Kelvin Smith Insurance
summary: UK broking consolidator Jensten Group agreed to buy Glasgow-based Kelvin Smith Insurance, a broker with roughly £22 million in premium and 3,000-plus clients, extending its third Scottish acquisition in recent years.

headline: Workflow-automation startup Pace raises $46M to help insurance agencies cut manual work
summary: Pace closed a $46 million funding round aimed at automating back-office and servicing workflows for insurance agencies and brokerages, part of a wave of venture capital targeting broker productivity tools.

headline: Sixfold debuts an AI underwriting agent built with major carriers
summary: Having previously raised a $30 million Series B, Sixfold launched its AI Underwriter, an agent developed over three years with large insurers to speed up submission triage, risk assessment and pricing guidance.

headline: IRDAI moves to spread insurance agent commissions across a policy's full term
summary: India's insurance regulator is preparing a consultation paper proposing that distributor commissions, currently front-loaded and as high as 40% of premium, be paid out over the life of a policy to curb mis-selling and reward ongoing customer service.

headline: Vantage Group taps former Arch Capital chief as it plots CEO succession
summary: Vantage named ex-Arch Capital CEO Marc Grandisson as executive chairman effective immediately, with David Gansberg set to become CEO once his non-compete obligations lapse in 2027.

headline: Commercial insurance rates keep softening across most lines in second quarter
summary: The latest Ivans Index shows renewal rates declining further in Q2 2026 for property, general liability and auto lines, while workers' comp and casualty diverge, signaling a broadening soft market for US commercial insurers.

headline: Malaysia's PolicyStreet tops up funding round to $26M with impact investor backing
summary: Embedded-insurance player PolicyStreet added $5 million from BlueOrchard's climate-resilience strategy to its Series C, bringing the round to $26 million as it expands digital insurance distribution across Southeast Asia and Australia.

headline: Survey finds only a third of UK consumers comfortable with AI-set insurance pricing
summary: A Guidewire consumer survey found roughly 30% of UK respondents would accept AI determining their policy pricing, with most wanting human oversight, transparency and independent regulation before trusting automated decisions more broadly.

headline: UnitedHealth's Optum wraps up purchase of benefits-account platform Alegeus
summary: Optum Financial finalized its takeover of Alegeus Technologies, a provider of HSA/FSA/HRA and COBRA administration software, aiming to broaden the range of consumer health-payment tools it can offer employers and health plans.

headline: Insurance-infrastructure startup Yuzu Health lands $35 million Series A
summary: Yuzu Health, which pivoted from building its own health plan to modernizing the back-end systems insurers use to administer coverage, closed a $35 million round led by General Catalyst and Chemistry with backing from Anthropic's venture arm.

headline: Optum taps Anthropic's Claude to automate claims and revenue-cycle work
summary: Optum unveiled a strategic tie-up with Anthropic to weave the Claude model into everyday insurance operations, targeting faster claims adjudication and less manual paperwork while keeping clinicians in the decision loop.

headline: ACA exchange enrollment plunges by 2.6 million as enhanced subsidies lapse
summary: Federal figures show marketplace sign-ups fell from roughly 21.8 million to 19.2 million year over year, the steepest drop since the exchanges launched, as expired premium tax credits push out-of-pocket costs sharply higher for many enrollees.

headline: AdventHealth and Intermountain agree to pool Denver-area hospitals into a joint venture
summary: The two health systems signed a letter of intent to combine five AdventHealth hospitals with three Intermountain facilities in metro Denver, a move that would reshape competition in the Colorado hospital market.

headline: Medicare-focused tech firm Pearl Health secures $110 million to scale AI risk tools
summary: Pearl Health raised a mix of equity and credit, led by Andreessen Horowitz and Trinity Capital, to expand its AI platform that helps providers manage Medicare and Medicare Advantage risk-based contracts.

headline: HCA Healthcare trims 2026 profit guidance as uninsured patient volumes rise
summary: HCA lowered its full-year net income forecast by roughly $1 billion, blaming the fallout from ACA marketplace disruption and softer surgical volumes; the news dragged down shares across other for-profit hospital operators too.

headline: States move to force disclosure of private-equity hospital buyouts
summary: With private equity firms now owning close to one in ten U.S. private hospitals, a growing number of states have begun requiring pre-closing notification and public review of PE-led hospital transactions, including ownership and financing details.

headline: MemorialCare's two-decade CEO steps aside for his successor
summary: Barry Arbuckle, who led MemorialCare for 24 years, moved into an executive chairman role as President David Kim took over as chief executive of the Southern California health system.

headline: UK cabinet reshuffle installs Yvette Cooper as Health Secretary
summary: Cooper moved from the Foreign Office to take charge of health and social care policy, with maternity-care improvements and social-care reform cited as immediate priorities for the NHS.

headline: Singapore convenes regional leaders to showcase next-wave clinical AI deployment
summary: Smart Health Asia 2026 drew thousands of attendees and executives from major Singaporean hospitals to spotlight how digital-health tools are moving from pilot projects to everyday clinical use across the region.

headline: Protective Life pushes beyond L&A, buys specialty P&C carrier Obsidian from Genstar
summary: Protective Life Insurance Company agreed to acquire specialty property & casualty platform Obsidian Insurance Holdings from private-equity owner Genstar Capital, a diversification move expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027.

headline: Ascensus scoops up AmericanTCS to bulk up trust and custody arm
summary: Recordkeeping giant Ascensus struck a deal to acquire AmericanTCS, adding trust, custody and technology-automation capabilities aimed at recordkeepers, bank trust companies, insurers and asset managers; terms weren't disclosed and the deal is slated to close in Q3 2026.

headline: Fidelity follows Vanguard and BlackRock in wiring annuities into 401(k) target-date funds
summary: Fidelity plans to launch a 'Freedom Lifetime' collective investment trust suite in early 2027 that embeds guaranteed lifetime income from Nationwide and New York Life into target-date funds, joining Vanguard-TIAA and BlackRock's LifePath Paycheck in mainstreaming in-plan annuities.

headline: DOL fiduciary safe harbor could open 401(k) menus to private equity
summary: Following President Trump's 2025 executive order, the Department of Labor advanced a proposed six-factor safe harbor letting plan fiduciaries add private equity, private credit and other alternatives to 401(k) lineups without automatically inviting litigation risk, potentially touching over 90 million DC savers.

headline: Invesco closes takeover of Morgan Stanley's retail asset management arm
summary: Invesco completed its previously announced purchase of Morgan Stanley's retail asset management business, including the Van Kampen lineup, as consolidation among traditional asset managers continues to accelerate.

headline: Insurers' Q2 books get a lift as investment income outruns catastrophe losses
