summary: Travelers posted 14% growth in net investment income to roughly $1.07 billion pre-tax in Q2 2026 as a stronger fixed-income portfolio and lighter storm losses drove net income to $2.21 billion, part of a broader pattern of insurers benefiting from elevated yields this earnings season.

headline: Lazard Asset Management's Hogbin reshapes the firm around AI and new hires
summary: Lazard Asset Management CEO Chris Hogbin is restructuring the firm with a wave of senior hires and a heavier bet on artificial intelligence tools, part of a broader push to reposition the asset manager competitively.

headline: WealthTech funding cools sharply in Q2 2026 after blockbuster Q1
summary: US WealthTech funding fell about 62% quarter-over-quarter to roughly $932 million in Q2 2026 even as the US kept about 54% of global deal share, with Germany's Bunch raising a $35 million Series B among the period's larger rounds.

headline: US commercial P&C rate growth cools to softest pace since 2017
summary: Alera Group's midyear analysis found commercial property/casualty premium growth flattened to roughly 0.2% in H1 2026 as insurer competition intensifies, marking the mildest pricing environment in nearly a decade even as some catastrophe-exposed lines stay firm.

headline: ANV buys workers' comp MGA Specialty Comp from Hub's SPG unit
summary: Global intermediary platform ANV Group Holdings acquired Texas-based Specialty Comp Insurance Solutions, a monoline workers' compensation MGA that wrote about $250M in premium in 2025, from Hub International's Specialty Program Group.

headline: North American broker M&A slumps to weakest first half since 2016
summary: Deal volume among P&C agents, brokers, benefits firms, MGAs and TPAs in the US and Canada fell about 15% to 292 transactions in H1 2026, the slowest pace in a decade as buyer-seller valuation gaps only partly narrowed.

headline: CorVel embeds AI intelligence layer directly into its claims platform
summary: Workers' comp TPA CorVel launched "CorVel Connected," an AI layer inside its CareMC claims system offering automated claim summaries, generative-AI document review, intelligent assignment and reserve predictions to speed adjuster decisions.

headline: Insurtech Corgi rockets to $4B valuation in third raise in 8 weeks
summary: AI-native startup carrier Corgi closed another extension of its Series B, lifting its valuation 54% to $4 billion just eight weeks after a $106M raise at $2.6B, underscoring investors' appetite for full-stack AI insurance platforms.

headline: Federato plants flag in APAC, opens Sydney office to chase AI underwriting demand
summary: AI-native underwriting platform Federato is expanding into Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Japan and Korea, opening a Sydney base and hiring a regional VP as it targets commercial-lines carriers and MGAs across the region.

headline: Insurer Genki buys German claims-tech startup Wave Claims
summary: Cologne-based Wave Claims and its Claim OS platform have been acquired by insurer Genki, giving it in-house AI claims-handling technology instead of relying on third-party vendors.

headline: Insurity hands CEO reins to Jatin Atre, backs it with $100M AI investment
summary: P&C-focused insurtech Insurity promoted president Jatin Atre to chief executive, with outgoing CEO Jeff Clarke shifting to executive chairman, alongside a fresh $100 million commitment to modernize its core systems with AI.

headline: UK regulator finalizes crypto capital rules that will touch insurers' balance sheets
summary: The FCA published final capital requirements for its stablecoin and cryptoasset regime, a rulebook that will shape how UK insurers and insurtechs holding or backing digital-asset exposures must reserve capital.

headline: InsuranceDekho lines up ~$1B IPO, targets September DRHP filing
summary: India's InsuranceDekho is preparing to file its draft IPO prospectus with SEBI by the end of September, reportedly seeking a valuation near ₹9,500 crore as it heads toward a public listing before March 2027.

headline: Fidelis and Howden go live on AI-driven Broker Connect submissions platform
summary: The Fidelis Partnership rolled out its AI-enabled Broker Connect platform with Howden as its first live broking partner, aiming to automate pre-bind submissions for complex commercial risks.

headline: Soft commercial market hands US brokers new negotiating leverage, CIAB finds
summary: CIAB's Q1 2026 survey found average commercial premiums fell 1.2% across all account sizes, the first broad decline in nearly nine years, while independent agents kept growing their share of the $1.1 trillion US P&C distribution market.

headline: Shepherd Insurance names its first-ever CIO as agency doubles down on tech
summary: Indiana-based Shepherd Insurance created a chief information officer role for the first time and appointed Collin Hill to it, signaling a deeper push into technology-led operations as the agency keeps growing.

headline: Trucking insurance brokerage buys its AI automation vendor outright, launches Insure Stack
summary: After using Mulligan to automate up to 90% of manual quoting and proposal work, Prestige Trucking Insurance acquired the AI platform from Pyq and relaunched it as a standalone company, Insure Stack, to sell the technology to other brokerages.

headline: UnitedHealth beats Q2, hikes 2026 profit outlook as costs ease
summary: UnitedHealth posted a large Q2 2026 earnings beat with a lower medical care ratio and raised full-year guidance, even while flagging expected member losses in ACA and Medicare Advantage plans due to affordability pressure.

headline: Molina's Q2 profit sinks 76% on rising medical costs, guidance still climbs
summary: Molina Healthcare's net income fell sharply in Q2 2026 as its medical loss ratio rose and premium revenue softened, yet the insurer still raised its full-year adjusted earnings guidance.

headline: HSBC offloads Singapore life and health insurance arm to Allianz for $2.1B
summary: HSBC agreed to sell its Singapore life and health insurance business to Allianz for roughly $2.1 billion, moving to a capital-light bancassurance model as it refocuses on wealth and wholesale banking in Asia.

headline: Cigna hands CEO reins to Brian Evanko as Cordani steps back
summary: The Cigna Group installed President and COO Brian Evanko as CEO effective July 1, 2026, while longtime chief executive David Cordani moved into an executive chairman role.

headline: Hospital M&A roars back with roughly 40 deals announced in H1 2026
summary: Hospital dealmaking has surged in 2026 after 2025's historic lull, with about 40 mergers and acquisitions announced in the first half of the year and analysts expecting the momentum to continue.

headline: Manipal Hospitals' Rs 6,300-crore Sahyadri buyout reshapes Indian care
summary: Manipal Hospitals is acquiring Sahyadri Hospitals in a roughly Rs 6,300 crore deal that adds 11 hospitals across Maharashtra, marking one of the largest consolidation moves yet in India's hospital sector.

headline: Private equity now owns nearly 1 in 10 US private hospitals
summary: A tracker of private-equity hospital ownership counted 447 PE-owned facilities as of June 2026, about 9.5% of all private hospitals, with a disproportionate share of their real estate held by REITs.

headline: CMS's proposed 2027 outpatient rule would deepen 340B payment cuts
summary: CMS's newly proposed CY2027 hospital outpatient payment rule would raise base rates 2.4% while further cutting reimbursement for drugs bought under the 340B discount program and tightening breakthrough-device payment pathways.

headline: Philips survey: AI is already freeing clinicians 16+ workdays a year
summary: Philips' 2026 Future Health Index, drawing on over 2,000 clinicians and 20,000 patients across 10 countries, found nearly half of clinicians save upwards of 130 hours a year using AI tools and are seeing more patients as a result.

headline: England to screen every newborn for spinal muscular atrophy
summary: The UK government confirmed on July 16 that newborn screening for spinal muscular atrophy will roll out nationwide across England, paired with a national evaluation program to track outcomes.

headline: PE-backed emergency medicine groups team up on Dignity Health contracts
summary: Emergency Care Partners, backed by Varsity Healthcare Partners, MidOcean Partners and Regal Healthcare Capital, struck a partnership with Phoenix-based Empower Emergency Physicians to staff Dignity Health's St. Joseph's hospitals.

headline: India's hospital chains post double-digit growth but margins tighten
summary: An EY-Parthenon analysis found major Indian hospital chains grew revenue and EBITDA more than 15% year-on-year in FY26, even as aggressive bed-capacity expansion squeezed operating margins across the sector.

headline: IRDAI clears another general insurance licence as 100% FDI draws fresh foreign interest
summary: India's insurance regulator approved a further general insurance licence, the second since the government raised the foreign direct investment ceiling to 100%, as overseas capital continues to target the sector.

headline: Jackson National named InvestmentNews' 2026 Annuities Provider of the Year
summary: Jackson National Life Insurance was recognized for product innovation, education and service at the InvestmentNews Awards, underscoring its continued scale in fixed and registered index-linked annuities as the carrier also marked a 14th consecutive year atop SQM's customer-service ranking.

headline: Globe Life lifts 2026 guidance after 7% Q2 revenue growth and stronger health premiums
summary: Globe Life reported second-quarter sales up 6.7% year over year to $1.6 billion, with health premium climbing 16% on strength at United American, prompting the insurer to raise its full-year earnings guidance.

headline: Shifting business models and valuations stall 401(k) recordkeeper consolidation
summary: Recordkeeper M&A activity has slowed as buyers and sellers struggle to agree on valuations amid evolving service models, even as pooled plans and expanding benefits offerings reshape what recordkeepers are expected to deliver.

headline: SEC-registered advisers now manage $176.8 trillion, up 22% in a year
summary: The Investment Adviser Association's 2026 industry snapshot shows SEC-registered investment advisers managing a record $176.8 trillion in assets for 73.7 million clients, with the number of registered firms hitting a new high of 16,544.

headline: Mapfre to acquire Safety Insurance for $1.54 billion
summary: Spain's Mapfre agreed to acquire Massachusetts-based Safety Insurance for $1.54 billion in cash, with Safety shareholders set to receive $105 per share, a 44% premium to the pre-announcement stock price.

headline: Macquarie-backed Enterprise Risk Associates acquires Florida's Insurance Solutions of America
summary: Enterprise Risk Associates, an insurance brokerage holding company backed by $150 million from Macquarie Capital, acquired Oviedo, Florida-based Insurance Solutions of America, a commercial brokerage specializing in fire suppression and life-safety risks, as it continues its agency-acquisition growth strategy.

headline: Alan's $550M round anchors a record first half for European insurtech funding
summary: French insurtech Alan's $550 million raise accounted for more than a third of all InsurTech funding in the first half of 2026, as the sector's H1 total already topped 2025's full-year figure at roughly $1.54 billion across 27 deals.

headline: Insurtech investment pivots toward commercial and specialty lines as climate-risk startups gain ground
summary: InsurTech capital is increasingly flowing to commercial insurance, specialty coverage and professional broker software rather than consumer apps, with climate and property-risk startups such as Arbol and Understory drawing investor interest.

headline: MedPAC pegs Medicare Advantage overpayments at $76 billion this year
summary: MedPAC estimates Medicare Advantage plans will be overpaid by roughly $76 billion in 2026 relative to the cost of covering similar beneficiaries in traditional Medicare, even as MA now covers 55% of eligible beneficiaries.

headline: Intermountain Health cuts charting time 27% after system-wide Dragon Copilot rollout
summary: Intermountain Health found that clinicians using Microsoft's Dragon Copilot ambient AI in 10 or more encounters saw a 27% reduction in time spent on notes per appointment, after a phased rollout that trained more than 1,400 staff with Accenture over 13 weeks.

headline: Candid Health raises $120M Series D led by Sixth Street, tripling its valuation
summary: Candid Health raised a $120 million Series D led by Sixth Street Growth with participation from Oak HC/FT, 8VC and Y Combinator, tripling its valuation versus its February 2025 Series C as the AI-driven revenue-cycle automation platform reports 190% year-over-year revenue growth.

headline: LIMRA lifts 2026 annuity sales forecast into record $438-485 billion range
summary: LIMRA's mid-year update projects total U.S. annuity sales will set a fresh record in 2026, extending a run of double-digit-billion quarters as registered index-linked annuities lead growth.

headline: Great Wealth Transfer and 'Peak 65' reshape 2026 life and annuity demand
summary: Industry analysis frames the generational handoff of wealth from boomers to millennials and Gen Z, alongside record numbers of Americans turning 65, as the defining force pushing lifetime-income products to the center of retirement planning conversations.

headline: BlackRock posts record margin and $192 billion of net inflows in Q2
summary: BlackRock's second-quarter results beat Wall Street estimates, with assets under management reaching $15.3 trillion and quarterly net inflows nearly tripling from a year earlier, pushing operating margin to a five-year high.

headline: Higher yields lift insurer investment income across Q2 earnings season
summary: Travelers reported a 14% jump in net investment income to $1.07 billion in the second quarter as its fixed-income portfolio benefited from higher yields and a larger asset base, a pattern echoed across other P&C carriers' Q2 results.

headline: Carlyle and Bain Capital narrow to a two-way, $7 billion race for Wealth Enhancement
summary: Private equity firms Carlyle and Bain Capital are the last bidders competing to acquire Wealth Enhancement Group, a roughly $160 billion RIA, in a deal valued near $7 billion including debt, according to a Financial Times report.

headline: RIA dealmaking tops $100 billion of AUM in motion through Q2 2026
summary: A wave of large platform transactions, including LPL/Private Advisor Group's acquisition of the $31 billion Mariner Advisor Network and Mesirow's purchase of LeafHouse Financial Advisors, is driving RIA M&A volumes even as deal count growth moderates.

headline: Orion becomes one of the first wealthtech firms to earn ISO 42001 AI certification
summary: Orion passed an independent audit to earn ISO/IEC 42001 certification for the AI management system governing its Denali AI layer, becoming the first portfolio-accounting provider and second advisor-tech firm overall to reach the standard.

headline: U.S. P/C industry logs its best underwriting result in a decade
summary: The U.S. property/casualty industry's combined ratio improved 3.6 points to 93 in 2025, its strongest underwriting performance in ten years, though results remain uneven between softening property rates and pressured casualty lines.

headline: Hanover Insurance names COO Richard Lavey as CEO-elect
summary: The Hanover Insurance Group disclosed that Chief Operating Officer Richard W. Lavey will become CEO-elect and succeed President and CEO John C. Roche, who plans to retire at the end of 2026.

headline: Allstate hires former CoStar finance chief as new CFO
summary: Allstate named a new chief financial officer with more than 25 years of capital-markets and leadership experience, most recently as CFO of commercial real estate data firm CoStar Group.

headline: EU clears Zurich's £8.1 billion takeover of Beazley
summary: The European Commission approved Zurich Insurance Group's all-cash acquisition of London-listed specialty insurer Beazley under simplified merger review, finding no competition concerns; the deal still awaits remaining regulatory sign-offs including from the UK's PRA.

headline: Reinsurance buyers keep the upper hand at mid-year renewals
summary: Brokers report cedents secured further rate relief and more flexible terms at July 1 reinsurance renewals, extending a softening cycle fueled by record global reinsurance capital and a quieter-than-feared catastrophe season.

headline: Insurance agency M&A hits slowest first half since 2016
summary: OPTIS Partners counted 292 U.S. and Canadian insurance agency deals in the first half of 2026, down 15% year over year and the weakest first-half tally in a decade, though dealmakers see the pace nearing a bottom.

headline: Goosehead Insurance CEO Mark Miller to retire at year-end
summary: Goosehead Insurance disclosed that founder-era chief executive Mark Miller will step down as CEO effective December 31, 2026, as the personal-lines distribution firm plans its next leadership phase.

headline: Insurer sues claims administrator over $2.48 million in unpaid claims
summary: Safety National and affiliated insurers sued third-party claims administrator S.A.F.E., alleging it walked away from contracts, left over 900 claims unhandled, and owes more than $5 million in claims-handling fees the insurer says were never earned.

headline: Digital tools reshape how third-party administrators handle claims
summary: Third-party administrators across insurance and employee benefits are leaning on automation and data analytics to cut administrative costs and improve transparency, as the global insurance TPA market is projected to grow from roughly $593 billion toward $845 billion by 2031.

headline: Marsh's Q2 revenue climbs as it leans further into producers and AI
summary: Business Insurance's weekly roundup highlights Marsh investing further in both frontline producers and AI tooling as a driver of its second-quarter revenue growth, alongside a wave of other broker technology moves.

headline: AI-native brokerage startup AGI raises $70 million to scale up
summary: American Growth Insurance secured nearly $70 million in committed equity to expand its AI-native insurance brokerage model, part of a broader push by startups to rebuild the distribution stack around automation.

headline: European insurtechs raise over €900 million in strongest first half in years
summary: European insurtech startups pulled in more than €900 million in the first half of 2026, already outpacing most recent full-year totals, with underwriting-automation deals showing particularly sharp growth.

headline: IAG taps OpenAI's new Presence platform for disaster-claims voice agents
summary: Australian insurer IAG became a launch customer for OpenAI's newly announced Presence agent platform, planning AI voice agents to triage simple, non-event claims during natural-catastrophe surges so human specialists can focus on complex cases.

headline: Blue Marble and MAPFRE widen access to parametric climate insurance
summary: Parametric insurance specialist Blue Marble partnered with global insurer MAPFRE to expand availability of climate-triggered parametric coverage for communities and businesses exposed to weather-related risks.

headline: UnitedHealth raises 2026 guidance again as cost controls take hold
summary: UnitedHealth Group posted $112 billion in second-quarter revenue and raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $19.50-$20.00, as its medical benefit ratio improved to 86.7% on benefit redesigns and tighter cost management.

headline: Elevance beats Q2 estimates but shares slide on margin worries
summary: Elevance Health topped second-quarter profit expectations and raised full-year guidance to at least $27 adjusted EPS, yet its stock fell more than 10% as investors focused on an 80-basis-point rise in its benefit expense ratio tied to government-program cost trends.

headline: Court challenge threatens to unwind parts of CMS's 2027 Medicare Advantage star-ratings overhaul
summary: A legal win by smaller carrier Clover Health against elements of CMS's revised Medicare Advantage star-ratings methodology could force regulators to revisit a rule that was expected to steer billions more in quality bonus payments to insurers.

headline: Sanford Health and Marshfield Clinic finalize $10 billion merger
summary: Sanford Health completed its combination with Marshfield Clinic Health System less than six months after announcing the deal, forming a 56-hospital nonprofit system and welcoming 13,000 new employees, with Sanford committing $500 million to Marshfield facilities over five years.

headline: Ambient AI scribes gain traction as a fix for clinician burnout
summary: Health systems are expanding ambient AI documentation tools well beyond early pilots, with reported burnout reductions of 20-30 percentage points at some organizations, even as costs of $100-$600 per provider per month keep return-on-investment questions open.

headline: AllianceBernstein poaches AIA strategist to lead new APAC insurance solutions team
summary: The $905 billion asset manager hired David Luo from AIA Group as head of insurance solutions for Asia-Pacific, based in Hong Kong, to help insurers with asset allocation and capital-efficient portfolio strategies.

headline: Arax signs deal for $3 billion RIA Transcend Capital Advisors, its seventh 2026 acquisition
summary: Arax Advisory Partners agreed to acquire New Jersey-based Transcend Capital Advisors, a multi-state RIA founded by former NYSE CEO Duncan Niederauer, expanding Arax's national wealth platform with more than 1,000 client relationships.

headline: Ellevest raises planning fees a third as advisor pricing climbs industrywide
summary: Women-focused RIA Ellevest lifted its annual financial planning fee from $3,600 to $4,800 and dropped monthly billing, part of a broader industry trend of rising advisor retainer fees.

headline: Sun Life debuts integrated private wealth platform to chase Asia's HNWI boom
summary: Sun Life launched "Sun Life Private Wealth," staffed by roughly 400 people across Hong Kong, Singapore, Bermuda, Dubai, Canada, Ireland and the US, targeting clients with at least $1 million in investable assets as Asian insurers race into wealth management.

headline: Louisiana doubles insurer cancellation notice period to 60 days
summary: Under Act No. 182, Louisiana insurers must now give at least 60 days' written notice before canceling or non-renewing most home, auto and commercial property policies, up from 30 days previously, except in cases of nonpayment.

headline: IRDAI weighs shift to trail-based commissions to curb insurance mis-selling
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering replacing large upfront agent commissions with payouts staggered over a policy's life and linked to persistency, with a consultation paper expected by the end of July 2026.

headline: INSTANDA links up with Diesta to bring payments into no-code policy administration
summary: No-code policy administration platform INSTANDA partnered with insurance payments infrastructure firm Diesta so carriers, MGAs and brokers can move from product launch to premium collection and reconciliation faster.

headline: Budapest-founded Ominimo becomes region's newest insurtech unicorn at $1.6 billion
summary: EBRD led a $22.5 million Series B for Ominimo, an AI-driven motor insurance MGA operating across European markets, pushing its valuation to $1.6 billion as it pursues its own insurance license.

headline: Oregon lifts supervision order over Medicare Advantage insurer ATRIO
summary: Oregon's Division of Financial Regulation ended its supervision of ATRIO Health Plans on July 14, three months after placing the insurer under oversight for a hazardous financial condition tied to over $52 million in 2025 operating losses.

headline: More health systems drop out of Medicare Advantage networks as July 1 deadlines hit
summary: Brown University Health physicians went out of network with UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plans and Moffitt Cancer Center dropped Humana MA plans effective July 1, continuing a wave of provider-payer contract breaks.

headline: Prudential-HCL joint venture becomes India's eighth standalone health insurer
summary: IRDAI granted a health insurance registration to Prudential HCL Health Insurance, a 70:30 joint venture between Prudential Plc and HCL Group's Vama Sundari Investments, the regulator's third new insurer license this year.

headline: Yvette Cooper takes over as UK Health and Social Care Secretary
summary: Cooper was appointed the UK's new Secretary of State for Health and Social Care and said she would prioritize maternity services and social care reform alongside ongoing NHS leadership changes.

headline: IAIS flags private credit and AI adoption as top global insurance supervisory priorities
summary: The International Association of Insurance Supervisors' mid-year Global Insurance Market Report highlighted growing life-insurer allocations to private credit, geoeconomic fragmentation and rapid AI adoption in underwriting as the leading risks supervisors are monitoring worldwide.

headline: Creative Planning expands into commercial insurance with Lovell acquisition
summary: The $710 billion RIA Creative Planning acquired Kansas City-area commercial insurance brokerage Lovell Insurance Group, continuing a run of specialized acquisitions that bring tax, legal and risk-management services under one roof.

headline: SEC-registered advisors now oversee $176.8 trillion, up 22% year-over-year
summary: More than 16,544 SEC-registered investment advisers collectively manage $176.8 trillion in assets as of mid-July, up 22.3% from a year earlier, with AI emerging as the dominant theme in new wealthtech product announcements.

headline: New disclosure rules extend to TPAs administering self-funded health plans
summary: Proposed DOL regulations and the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2026 expand advance-disclosure requirements to third-party administrators handling ERISA self-funded group health plans, with new compensation-disclosure duties phasing in for plan years beginning after mid-2026.

headline: PremFina secures £400 million debt facility from Lloyds as loan book triples
summary: UK insurance premium-finance provider PremFina secured a new £400 million senior debt facility from Lloyds, complementing an existing £100 million junior facility, after its loan book grew more than 300% over 18 months.

headline: BrokerTech Ventures and ManchesterStory launch dedicated broker-tech venture fund
summary: BrokerTech Ventures partnered with ManchesterStory to launch the BrokerTech Fund, the first venture capital vehicle targeting technology startups built specifically for insurance brokers and wholesalers.

headline: Allstate's SquareTrade launches licensed insurer in Brussels
summary: SquareTrade Europe, an Allstate company, launched a newly licensed insurer headquartered in Brussels to gain direct control over underwriting and speed product launches across its 15 European markets.

headline: Hospitals create new AI-focused clinical leadership roles
summary: Health systems including UCI Health and Providence named their first chief medical informatics and AI officers this year, reflecting a broader wave of hospitals adding dedicated C-suite roles to govern clinical AI deployment.

headline: NHS pushes new sepsis-prevention and quality strategy
summary: NHS England outlined new measures aimed at preventing thousands of sepsis deaths by 2035 as part of a broader Quality Strategy for NHS-funded care, alongside record cancer-check volumes reaching 3.4 million patients in a year.

headline: M&G Closes £150 Million Bulk Annuity Deal for UK Pension Scheme
summary: Prudential Assurance, part of M&G, finalized a £150 million bulk purchase annuity transaction covering around 1,200 members of a UK pension scheme sponsored by an insurance company, reflecting continued strong competition in Britain's pension de-risking market.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life Elevates Conor Murphy to Chief Executive
summary: F&G Annuities & Life announced a leadership overhaul in which Conor Murphy succeeds retiring CEO Chris Blunt, alongside other executive changes including a new chief financial officer, effective mid-2026.

headline: IRDAI Figures Show Indian Insurance Premiums More Than Tripled Over the Decade
summary: New regulator data shows life insurance premiums growing roughly 2.5-2.6 times and total insurance premiums surging 3.6 times over the past ten years, with brokers now placing 42% of general insurance premium as India pushes toward universal coverage by 2047.

headline: Insurers Push AI Adoption Past Underwriting Into Service and Product Design
summary: A new GlobalData industry poll finds underwriting still tops the list of AI use cases for insurers, but its lead is narrowing as carriers increasingly apply AI to customer service and product development, pointing to broader enterprise-wide adoption.

headline: Plan Sponsors Face Year-End Deadline to Lock In SECURE Act Amendments
summary: Employers must formally adopt required SECURE Act, CARES Act and SECURE 2.0 plan amendments by December 31, 2026, even as newer rules such as mandatory Roth catch-up contributions for higher earners and paper-statement mandates are already taking effect.

headline: Recordkeepers Race to Bake AI Into Retirement Income Tools
summary: Major providers are rolling out AI-driven retirement income planning features with dynamic withdrawal strategies, though commentators note most asset managers still haven't incorporated AI into glidepath design or risk management for target-date defaults.

headline: PFRDA Makes Pension Funds Liable for Third-Party Failures Under NPS
summary: India's pension regulator notified amended exit-and-withdrawal rules making pension funds accountable to subscribers for lapses by outside entities engaged to run specific-purpose schemes, alongside new regulatory-sandbox rules to test pension innovations.

headline: Insurer Stocks Rally as Investors Rotate Into Safe Havens Amid AI Jitters
summary: US insurance shares jumped as much as 2.8% on the S&P 500 Insurance Index as traders nervous about an AI-driven market pulled money into defensive names, with brokers like Willis Towers Watson among the biggest gainers.

headline: Treasury Confirms BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street ETFs for New Child Savings Accounts
summary: The US Treasury said the newly launched tax-advantaged "Trump Accounts" for children will offer index ETFs from BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street, with a government seed contribution for babies born between 2025 and 2028 and several employers matching it.

headline: RIA dealmaking sets new second-quarter record as PE-backed buyers dominate
summary: Echelon Partners' Q2 2026 report found 120 RIA transactions worth $378 billion in AUM changed hands, the busiest second quarter on record, with private-equity-backed acquirers again driving the bulk of activity.

headline: Envestnet pushes AI explainability tools deeper into advisor workflows
summary: At its Elevate 2026 conference, Envestnet unveiled new AI explainability, workflow-transparency and decisioning features for its wealth data platform, aimed at helping advisors trust and act on AI-generated insights.

headline: Manulife taps Brett Marchand to lead its wealth arm after abrupt exit of predecessor
summary: Manulife Wealth & Asset Management named longtime executive Brett Marchand as president and CEO of Manulife Wealth after Richard McIntyre departed for another opportunity, alongside other Canada retirement leadership moves.

headline: State-run Central Bank of India to enter wealth management and card business for fee income
summary: Central Bank of India's CEO said the state-owned lender has board approval to launch wealth management and re-enter the credit-card business in the second half of the fiscal year as it seeks to boost non-interest income.

headline: Swiss Re warns current soft P&C cycle may be shallower than past downturns
summary: Swiss Re research suggests the ongoing softening in global property-casualty pricing could be less steep than prior soft markets, as rising repair costs and growing catastrophe losses limit how far rates can fall.

headline: Florida's insurance-crisis fixes are leaving homeowners with less claims leverage, report finds
summary: A national regulators' report found several Florida property insurers closed more claims without payment in 2025 than in 2023, suggesting the state's reforms aimed at stabilizing the market have shifted more risk onto homeowners.

headline: Hanover Insurance sets up leadership handover as longtime CEO Roche plans exit
summary: The Hanover Insurance Group said President and CEO John Roche will retire at the end of 2026 after roughly a decade in the role, with Chief Operating Officer Richard Lavey named CEO-elect to take over.

headline: UK insurers flag AI-fabricated case law as a fresh professional indemnity risk
summary: UK insurers and law firms issued guidance warning that lawyers and other professionals relying on generative AI that invents fake case citations now represents a genuine and growing professional indemnity exposure.

headline: AI-driven auto MGA Mile Auto scoops up Georgia agency to bulk up Southeast distribution
summary: Pay-per-mile insurance MGA Mile Auto acquired The Insurance House, combining its AI and computer-vision underwriting tech with the Georgia agency's six-decade network of independent agents to form a nearly $100 million premium platform.

headline: Sedgwick debuts Omni, an integrated AI-powered claims and risk platform
summary: Sedgwick unveiled Omni, a proprietary digital ecosystem combining its claims data with AI and machine learning to support document summarization, triage, severity modeling, automated reserving and fraud detection across the claims lifecycle.

headline: Budapest motor-insurance fintech Ominimo hits $1.6 billion valuation on fresh Series B
summary: Ominimo, which applies AI and data analytics to motor insurance pricing, raised $22.5 million in a Series B round that values the profit-focused company at roughly $1.6 billion.

headline: Visa teams with insurtech Neat to modernize embedded card insurance
summary: Payments giant Visa is partnering with French insurtech Neat to give cardholders clearer coverage information and faster claims resolution as part of a push to embed insurance benefits more seamlessly into card products.

headline: Willis and Qover team up to expand embedded-insurance offering across industries
summary: Broking giant Willis and Belgian insurtech Qover launched a partnership widening the GB Affinity ecosystem, aiming to give businesses a fast, product-agnostic way to launch point-of-sale insurance programs at scale.

headline: Zywave survey finds AI now a deciding factor in how employers pick brokers
summary: Zywave's 2026 Broker Services Survey shows artificial intelligence has shifted from a background trend to an explicit criterion employers weigh when choosing and evaluating their insurance brokers.

headline: Global commercial insurance pricing keeps falling as soft market persists into Q2 2026
summary: Marsh's latest Global Insurance Market Index shows commercial rates declining again in the second quarter of 2026, extending a multi-quarter softening trend driven by abundant capacity, even as US casualty pricing continues to buck the downward trend.

headline: AI insurtech Corgi raises fresh capital at $4 billion valuation, its third round in three months
summary: San Francisco-based Corgi closed another funding round in late July that pushed its valuation to about $4 billion, marking its third capital raise in under three months amid a broader resurgence in insurtech investor interest.

headline: Bengaluru insurtech NeuralKart lands seed funding for AI underwriting tools
summary: NeuralKart, which builds AI-driven decision tools to automate underwriting, claims processing and industrial safety checks, raised a Rs 2.35 crore seed round led by Inflection Point Ventures.

headline: CMS Confirms Medicare Part D Premium Subsidy Will Expire After 2026
summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services confirmed it will let a demonstration program that has been holding down Part D premiums lapse at the end of the 2026 plan year. Analysts warn the move could push drug-plan premiums higher for a large share of Medicare's senior population starting in 2027.

headline: Elevance Health Shares Tumble Despite Earnings Beat as Margins Shrink
summary: Elevance topped quarterly profit and revenue estimates and raised its full-year guidance, yet its stock sold off as investors focused on shrinking operating margins in its core health-benefits and Medicaid business. The mixed reaction dragged down shares of peer managed-care insurers as well.

headline: Centene Rebounds to Over $1 Billion Profit, Raises Guidance Again
summary: Centene swung back to profitability with more than $1 billion in second-quarter earnings as premium increases and rate hikes offset elevated medical costs. The insurer raised its 2026 earnings outlook for the second time this year.

headline: Insurers Lean Harder on AI to Rework Prior Authorization
summary: A growing share of health plans are deploying artificial intelligence to speed up prior-authorization decisions, with many insurers pledging faster real-time approvals. Physician groups remain wary that AI-driven review could just as easily increase denials as reduce delays.

headline: Singapore Tightens Rules on Private Health Insurance Riders to Curb Cost Spiral
summary: Singapore's Ministry of Health introduced new requirements for Integrated Shield Plan riders, including higher mandatory co-payments, aimed at reining in rapidly rising private healthcare costs. The changes are expected to lower new rider premiums by roughly 30% as medical inflation in the country is projected near 17% this year.

headline: AdventHealth and Intermountain Health Plot Denver-Area Hospital Tie-Up
summary: The two health systems signed a letter of intent to affiliate five AdventHealth hospitals with three Intermountain facilities in the Denver metro area. The move is part of a broader wave of regional hospital consolidation this year.

headline: UpDoc Becomes First FDA-Cleared AI Platform With Patient-Facing Chat
summary: UpDoc received FDA clearance for what it describes as the first agentic clinical AI platform built around a patient-facing large language model, with early rollouts at several major health systems. The company positions the tool as a clinician support system rather than a replacement for physicians.

headline: UK Government Pours £30 Million Into AI Cancer-Diagnosis Rollout
summary: The UK government announced nearly £30 million in funding to expand AI-assisted X-ray analysis to every NHS trust in England by 2029 and pilot new AI diagnostic tools at a dozen additional sites. Existing AI tools have already helped over four million patients get faster lung-cancer diagnoses.
source_name: GOV.UK / Department of Health and Social Care

headline: UK Launches First National Digital Pathology Network With UCLH Neurology
summary: University College London Hospitals' neurology department joined the NPIC digital pathology platform, described as the UK's first national infrastructure for AI-assisted pathology. The onboarding expands a growing national push to digitize tissue diagnostics for AI analysis.

headline: Apollo Hospitals Set to Outpace Rivals as India's Hospital Chains Post Strong Quarter
summary: Analysts at Jefferies expect India's major hospital operators, including Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare, Fortis, and Global Health, to post double-digit revenue growth this quarter on strong patient volumes. Apollo is forecast to lead the group even as new-facility expansion costs weigh on sector margins.

headline: Mapfre takes a stake in Spanish digital insurer Tuio to deepen AI push
summary: Spanish insurance giant Mapfre agreed to buy a 38.9% stake in Tuio, a fully digital Spanish insurtech with over 100,000 customers, as part of a broader push into agile, AI-driven distribution that follows Mapfre's separate $1.5 billion purchase of Safety Insurance in the US.

headline: Gallagher brings in dedicated Nordics deal-insurance lead as its M&A practice grows
summary: Broking giant Gallagher hired Gabriella Eriksen Wingren, previously of EQT and PwC Sweden, to head transaction solutions for the Nordics within its private equity and M&A practice, adding dedicated warranty-and-indemnity expertise as the region's deal activity picks up.

headline: Ryan Specialty's wholesale unit RT Specialty names new CEO in planned handover
summary: RT Specialty confirmed that Ryan Specialty co-president Brendan Mulshine will take over as CEO effective August 1, 2026, with outgoing chief Ed McCormack moving to vice chairman, alongside several other leadership moves across the wholesale brokerage's practice groups.

headline: India's insurance regulator rolls out sweeping reforms to modernize the sector
summary: IRDAI approved a package of reforms implementing the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha insurance law amendments, easing capital and investment norms, simplifying corporate restructuring, tightening actuarial oversight, and setting up a uniform penalty framework alongside a new policyholder protection fund.

headline: Vertafore rolls out an AI agent to automate employee benefits plan setup for brokers
summary: Vertafore launched a new Velocity AI Benefit Plan Agent inside its BenefitPoint module, aimed at helping brokers automate benefit-plan configuration during the busy renewal season with claimed accuracy around 90%, part of a wider six-agent AI platform it unveiled earlier this year.

headline: Insurtech Qumis debuts AI agents to give smaller insurance firms faster coverage analysis
summary: Chicago-based Qumis launched a set of AI agents that perform citation-backed coverage analysis across 16 insurance lines including cyber, D&O and workers' comp in minutes, pitched at brokers, carriers, MGAs and claims teams looking to close the technology gap with larger competitors.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC's Singapore life and health insurance arm in $2 billion deal
summary: German insurer Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore, a composite insurer that underwrites health, life and medical products, for roughly S$2.7 billion, while also entering a 15-year exclusive bancassurance partnership with HSBC in the city-state; the deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

headline: India's insurance regulator licenses Prudential-HCL joint venture as newest standalone health insurer
summary: IRDAI granted a certificate of registration to Prudential HCL Health Insurance, a 70:30 joint venture between UK-based Prudential and India's HCL Group, making it the eighth standalone health insurer in the country and the third new insurance license the regulator has issued so far in 2026.

headline: ACA marketplace enrollment set to plunge as premium subsidies shrink and the 'subsidy cliff' returns
summary: With enhanced pandemic-era premium tax credits expired, KFF projects effectuated ACA marketplace enrollment could fall to roughly 17.5 million people in 2026 from 22.3 million in 2025, driven largely by middle-income shoppers now facing the return of an income cap on subsidy eligibility and average monthly premium payments up around 58%.

headline: Clinical AI startup Bunkerhill Health raises $55 million to expand agentic AI tools inside hospitals
summary: Bunkerhill Health closed a Series B led by Khosla Ventures, with Sequoia, Felicis, Optum Ventures and Y Combinator participating, bringing total funding to $55 million to scale its Carebricks platform that lets health systems build AI agents for clinical, operational and administrative tasks; the platform is already live at Cleveland Clinic, UTMB and Intermountain Health.

headline: Manipal Health commits roughly $414 million to expand hospital capacity as its IPO closes
summary: Manipal Health Enterprises plans to invest about ₹3,560 crore over the next three to four years to grow its hospital network, disclosed as its roughly ₹9,275 crore initial public offering wrapped up subscription on July 31; a large share of IPO proceeds will retire acquisition debt and buy out remaining minority stakes from recent deals like Sahyadri Hospitals.

headline: OU Health hands the CEO role to its COO as founding chief executive retires
summary: Jonathan Curtright, who had served as chief operating officer, became president and CEO of OU Health on July 1, succeeding founding CEO Richard Lofgren; under Curtright's operational leadership the Oklahoma system's annual revenue nearly doubled to a projected $3.7 billion with double-digit growth in admissions.

headline: RIA dealmaking hits record pace in first half of 2026, fueled by private equity
summary: Wealth management M&A surged in the first half of 2026, with 225 deals involving RIAs holding at least $100 million in assets announced through June, up 39% from a year earlier, as private-equity-backed firms accounted for the vast majority of strategic buyers.

headline: Advisor software makers push AI planning agents further into daily workflows
summary: Wealthtech vendors rolled out new AI tools in quick succession, including Altruist's forthcoming 'Hazel' agent meant to shrink an 18-hour financial-planning process to minutes and RightCapital's 'Iris' assistant that flags data gaps, while Orion became one of the first wealthtech firms certified under the ISO/IEC 42001 AI-management standard.

headline: Singapore overhauls rulebook for single-family offices
summary: A revised regulatory framework for single-family offices from Singapore's central bank took effect in mid-June 2026, streamlining setup procedures for new offices while tightening ongoing monitoring, as the city-state's family-office count has grown past 1,500 from under 200 seven years ago.

headline: SEC eyes easing political-donation restrictions on investment advisers
summary: The SEC's newly released 2026 rulemaking agenda includes a plan to amend its long-standing pay-to-play rule governing political contributions by investment advisers, part of a broader 38-item agenda that leans toward deregulation and wider retail access to private markets.

headline: Tata Asset Management promotes longtime insider Vardarajan to top job
summary: Tata Asset Management named Anand Vardarajan, previously its chief business officer, as CEO and managing director effective July 10, 2026, succeeding Prathit Bhobe, while also elevating Hemant Kumar to chief business officer in the same leadership shuffle.

headline: Europe's largest pension manager installs permanent chief executive
summary: Dutch pension giant APG Asset Management formally appointed Alineke van den Berge-Blindenbach as chief executive effective July 1, 2026, confirming a role she had held on an interim basis since March after previously serving as chief operating officer.

headline: Cincinnati Financial's investment income jumps as bond yields climb
summary: Cincinnati Financial reported a 12% year-over-year rise in second-quarter 2026 investment income, aided by stronger fixed-income yields and insurance cash flow, contributing to a sharp increase in net income and earnings per share versus a year earlier.

headline: Wellington, Vanguard and Blackstone jointly debut blended public-private funds
summary: The three asset managers launched new closed-end funds combining public and private market exposure in single portfolios, initially distributed through Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank, as part of a distribution alliance the firms announced in 2025.

headline: India's newer specialised investment fund category posts sharp monthly asset growth
summary: Assets in India's Specialised Investment Fund category climbed 29% in June 2026 to about Rs 17,858 crore according to a ValueMetrics report, with hybrid long-short strategies making up nearly three-quarters of the category's total assets.

headline: US managing general agent premiums climb to roughly $128 billion
summary: A new Conning study finds the US MGA and delegated-underwriting market grew to about $128 billion in premium in 2025, driven by continued private equity and venture capital interest, technology adoption, and ongoing consolidation among program administrators.

headline: IRDAI drafts stricter disclosure rules for high-earning insurance intermediaries
summary: India's insurance regulator issued a consultation paper requiring brokers and other intermediaries that earn more than roughly Rs 10 crore in annual commissions to disclose commission income, related-party dealings and profit details, and to publish them on their websites, as part of a broader push to curb mis-selling.

headline: Vertafore rolls out AI agent to speed up MGA submission intake
summary: Insurance technology provider Vertafore launched an AI-powered submission processing agent that pulls structured data from unstructured broker submissions like emails and PDFs, aiming to cut manual intake work for managing general agents, with early users reporting roughly 87% accuracy.

headline: Catastrophe reinsurance prices post steepest annual drop in 25 years
summary: Global property-catastrophe reinsurance rates fell roughly 16% year-on-year at the June/July 2026 renewals, the sharpest annual decline in a quarter-century, as record reinsurance capital and a fifth consecutive quarter of below-average catastrophe losses gave cedents more negotiating leverage.

headline: Bank of England regulators unveil plan for new UK captive insurance regime
summary: The PRA and FCA jointly proposed a tailored regulatory framework for captive insurers in the UK, featuring lower capital floors, streamlined governance, faster application turnaround, and reduced reporting burdens, with the new regime targeted to launch in summer 2027 after a consultation closing in October 2026.

headline: Insurers lean on agentic AI to rebuild underwriting and claims workflows
summary: A new industry report finds property and casualty insurers are increasingly adopting agentic AI to power decision-centric underwriting, claims and customer service operations, often via orchestration layers that connect the new tools with legacy policy administration systems.

headline: Serbian-Hungarian digital motor insurer Ominimo becomes the Balkans' first unicorn
summary: Digital motor insurer Ominimo closed a EUR20.1 million Series B round backed by the EBRD's venture arm at a EUR1.4 billion valuation, reaching profitability and unicorn status only about two years after its 2024 launch on the strength of data-driven pricing technology.

headline: Gallagher Bassett leans on flexible adjuster model as severe weather strains claims volumes
summary: Facing a surge of complex, weather-driven claims, TPA giant Gallagher Bassett described shifting to an integrated field-and-desk adjusting model that lets it flex resources on demand, arguing that resilience and adaptability are becoming the differentiators for claims partners as catastrophe risk intensifies.

headline: Embedded-insurance platform Cover Genius raises $100M, now valued near $2 billion
summary: Cover Genius, a New York-based embedded-protection insurtech, closed a $100 million raise backed by Vista Credit Partners that pushes its valuation to roughly $1.9 billion, with proceeds earmarked for expanding AI-driven personalization and claims tools and funding further acquisitions.

headline: Matic buys Policygenius's property-casualty book while taking on new capital partner
summary: Insurance-technology platform Matic acquired roughly 30,000 home and auto policies from Policygenius's property-casualty portfolio and simultaneously secured a minority growth investment from Primus Capital to fund further embedded-insurance partnerships and acquisitions.

headline: UK's FCA pushes further insurance rule simplification, easing cross-border and disclosure burdens
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority published a new consultation proposing to narrow the territorial scope of its insurance conduct rules and strip out disclosure requirements it views as duplicative, continuing a broader effort to streamline regulation for insurers, intermediaries and MGAs.

headline: US annuity sales set fresh quarterly record in Q2 2026
summary: LIMRA's preliminary figures show total US annuity sales climbing 4% year-over-year to an all-time high of $123.9 billion in the second quarter, extending an 11-quarter streak above $100 billion on strong fixed-rate deferred and income annuity demand.

headline: Malibu Life recruits a Prudential retirement executive as its new chief executive
summary: London-listed reinsurer Malibu Life Holdings named Todd Shriber, formerly head of strategy for Prudential Financial's global retirement and insurance businesses, as CEO effective July 20, as the firm expands into US direct annuity origination following its TruSpire acquisition.

headline: Indian life insurers push AI deeper into underwriting and claims workflows
summary: ICICI Prudential Life and HDFC Life are moving artificial intelligence from pilot projects into everyday underwriting, claims processing, fraud detection and servicing, part of a broader industry shift toward AI-driven efficiency across the policy lifecycle.

headline: UK pension trustees told to brace for DC megafund rules as new pensions law takes effect
summary: With the Pension Schemes Act 2026 having received Royal Assent, advisers are highlighting a revised implementation roadmap, a Value for Money framework consultation and new scale requirements that will eventually push smaller DC schemes toward consolidation into multi-billion-pound master trusts.

headline: Japan pushes its $1.8 trillion pension giant to triple alternative-asset exposure
summary: Japanese officials are urging GPIF, the world's largest pension fund, to lift allocations to private equity, real estate, credit and infrastructure from about 1.7% toward a 5% target as part of a broader overhaul of its investment strategy.

headline: Pooled employer plans become a top growth bet for 401(k) recordkeepers
summary: A new Cerulli report finds recordkeepers expect pooled employer plans to drive a growing share of new business, with adoption already up sharply year-over-year and most recordkeepers now supporting PEPs as a strategic priority.

headline: F&G Annuities & Life set to report Q2 2026 earnings August 5 after prior-quarter miss
summary: Analysts expect F&G to post roughly $0.82 EPS on $1.49 billion of revenue when it reports second-quarter results, following a first-quarter miss versus consensus estimates.

headline: Pooled Employer Plan adoption jumps 45% as recordkeepers make PEPs a strategic priority
summary: The 2026 PLANSPONSOR/Cerulli recordkeeping survey found 10,797 employers have now adopted PEPs for their 401(k) or 403(b) participants, up from 7,454 a year earlier, with most recordkeepers calling PEPs a major or moderate strategic priority.

headline: AXA underlying profit rises 2% to €4.5 billion as insurer refocuses after asset-management sale
summary: AXA's earnings beat expectations for the first half of 2026, with CEO Thomas Buberl looking to strengthen the core insurance business following the group's €5.1 billion divestiture of its asset-management arm earlier this year.

headline: Vanguard and Fidelity push ahead with target-date fund glide-path overhauls as TDF assets near $5 trillion
summary: Both fund giants are mid-way through reallocating target-date series toward higher equity exposure in early-dated vintages, changes Morningstar says continue to reshape the nearly $5 trillion target-date fund category that anchors most workplace retirement defaults.

headline: RIA M&A activity shatters records with first-half deal count up nearly 40% year over year
summary: Independent RIA consolidation is accelerating in 2026 as private-equity-backed acquirers and roll-ups compete for scale, with deal volume in the first half already approaching 40% above last year's pace.

headline: Carlyle and Bain Capital reportedly bid for Wealth Enhancement Group as PE appetite for RIAs intensifies
summary: Private equity interest in large independent wealth managers is heating up, with Carlyle Group and Bain Capital said to be competing for a stake in Wealth Enhancement Group, one of the country's larger RIA aggregators.

headline: Altruist launches AI planning agent 'Hazel' as AI-native wealth manager Arca raises $64 million
summary: Custodial platform Altruist rolled out an AI-driven financial planning agent for advisors, the same week AI-native wealth manager Arca closed a $64 million funding round, underscoring how fast agentic AI is moving into core advisor workflows.

headline: US P&C insurers post $15.8 billion Q1 underwriting gain, reversing year-ago loss
summary: Private US property/casualty insurers swung to a first-quarter 2026 underwriting profit of $15.8 billion, a sharp turnaround from the $864 million underwriting loss recorded in the same period last year.

headline: P&C market splits in two directions: property rates soften while casualty lines keep hardening
summary: Property insurance pricing is easing after a muted catastrophe year and a wave of reinsurance capital, even as casualty lines continue to harden under pressure from social inflation, larger jury awards and aggressive litigation funding.

headline: Commercial auto insurers have absorbed more than $10 billion in underwriting losses over two years
summary: Commercial auto liability remains the most stressed P&C line, with carriers continuing to post outsized underwriting losses as claim severity from litigation and jury verdicts keeps outpacing rate increases.

headline: Acies MGU launches ports-and-terminals specialist TEDmar International
summary: Acies MGU unveiled TEDmar International, a new managing general agent focused on marine ports and terminals risk, led by veteran marine underwriters, as part of a wider wave of specialty MGA launches this week.

headline: Global MGA and coverholder market revenue reaches $17.3 billion on 19% annual growth
summary: Delegated underwriting continues to expand rapidly worldwide, with the global MGA, MGU and coverholder segment now generating an estimated $17.3 billion in revenue as carriers lean further on third-party underwriting capacity.

headline: Allianz agrees to acquire HSBC's Singapore health and life insurance business for €2 billion
summary: Allianz will take over HSBC's Singapore life and health insurance operations in a €2 billion deal expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending approval from Singapore's Monetary Authority, expanding Allianz's Asian footprint.

headline: Zywave expands AI platform aimed at reshaping insurance distribution growth
summary: Insurance software provider Zywave broadened its AI product suite for agencies and brokers, adding capabilities aimed at automating sales workflows and accelerating growth for distribution partners.

headline: CMS finalizes 2027 Medicare Advantage rates with payments up nearly 5% for insurers
summary: The Trump administration backed off elements of its original Medicare Advantage rate proposal, finalizing 2027 payment rates that raise average per-enrollee payments to private insurers by close to 5%, roughly double the initially proposed increase.

headline: Cigna raises 2026 earnings outlook after employer-plan profits jump on premium hikes
summary: Cigna's employer-sponsored plan segment delivered stronger-than-expected profit in the second quarter after premium increases, leading the insurer to raise its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $30.45, joining peers in a beat-and-raise quarter.

headline: Innovaccer and AWS sign multi-year deal to deploy agentic AI across health systems and payers
summary: Innovaccer and Amazon Web Services signed a multi-year strategic collaboration to help health systems and payers move agentic AI deployments from pilot to production at the security, compliance and scale healthcare organizations require.

headline: ONC releases USCDI version 7 and names nine EHIgnite Challenge Phase 1 winners
summary: The Office of the National Coordinator published version 7 of the US Core Data for Interoperability standard, adding 30 new data elements, and named nine Phase 1 winners of its EHIgnite Challenge to turn dense health records into clearer AI-generated summaries for patients and clinicians.

headline: IRDAI weighs overhaul of insurance distributor commissions to curb mis-selling
summary: India's insurance regulator is considering replacing large upfront commission payouts to distributors with payments staggered over a policy's life, an effort to improve customer outcomes and align India's distribution rules with global norms.

headline: India's Bima Sugam insurance marketplace to launch motor, health and term products by September
summary: The government-backed Bima Sugam platform is on track to roll out its first motor, health and term insurance products by the end of September as participating insurers complete technology integration work.

headline: EIOPA presses private equity buyers of European insurers to prove long-term commitment
summary: Europe's insurance regulator is requiring private equity firms seeking to acquire European insurers to demonstrate they can support policyholders well beyond a typical five-year holding period before approving deals.

headline: AIPSO names Les Willis president and CEO as Charles Kwolek retires after 32 years
summary: The Automobile Insurance Plans Service Office promoted Executive Vice President Les Willis to president and CEO, succeeding longtime leader Charles Kwolek, who is retiring after a 32-year career with the organization.

headline: AXIS Capital posts higher Q2 fee income from strategic capital partner arrangements
summary: AXIS Capital reported another quarter of rising fee income from its third-party capital and insurance-linked securities partnerships, part of a broader industry shift toward fee-generating alternative capital structures.

headline: New DOL disclosure rule for TPAs and PBMs on self-funded ERISA plans takes effect
summary: A Department of Labor regulation proposed in January 2026 requiring third-party administrators and PBMs to give employers extensive advance fee and compensation disclosures when contracting on self-funded ERISA group health plans became applicable for plan years beginning on or after July 1, 2026.

headline: Allianz to buy HSBC's Singapore life and health insurance unit in €2 billion deal with 15-year distribution tie-up
summary: Allianz agreed to acquire HSBC Life Singapore and sign a 15-year exclusive bancassurance partnership with HSBC in the city-state, a combined €2 billion transaction expected to close in the first half of 2027.

headline: Globe Life lifts full-year profit guidance after broad-based Q2 underwriting gains
summary: Globe Life raised its 2026 earnings-per-share guidance after posting a 7% rise in total premium revenue for the second quarter, with life insurance underwriting margin outperforming and health premiums surging.

headline: India finalizes insurance-sector reforms allowing 100% foreign ownership of insurers
summary: IRDAI's board approved a package of reforms simplifying regulation, strengthening policyholder protection and permitting full foreign investment in Indian insurers, with two carriers already moving to raise foreign shareholding past the prior 74% cap.

headline: Great-West Lifeco's Empower unit crosses $2 trillion in U.S. workplace retirement assets, unveils platform acquisition
summary: Great-West Lifeco reported 15% year-over-year growth in base earnings per share for the second quarter and said its Empower retirement business surpassed $2 trillion in client assets while announcing a deal to strengthen its U.S. retirement platform.

headline: Fidelity, Vanguard and BlackRock push annuities into target-date 401(k) funds
summary: Major asset managers are building annuity-linked options into target-date funds, with Fidelity's planned Freedom Lifetime fund set to let retirees convert savings into guaranteed lifetime income from insurers starting in 2027.

headline: Target-date fund assets climb to $4.8 trillion as collective investment trusts gain ground, Morningstar finds
summary: Morningstar's 2026 landscape report shows target-date fund assets grew more than 20% year-over-year, with falling fees and rising use of lower-cost collective investment trusts reshaping how retirement plan sponsors pick defaults.

headline: Arax adds $3 billion RIA Transcend Capital Advisors in its seventh acquisition of 2026
summary: RedBird-backed aggregator Arax signed a definitive agreement to acquire Transcend Capital Advisors, a fiduciary-model RIA serving over 1,000 client relationships, continuing its run as one of the fastest-growing wealth platforms in the country.

headline: Wealth management panel says AI agents are the next major wave of advisor software
summary: Industry panelists at a WealthManagement.com event argued that 2026 will be remembered as the year AI agents move beyond meeting note-taking into broader advisory workflows, even as most advisors are still just testing the tools.

headline: Accelerated Wealth Partners makes its first investment, backing a $1.6 billion Houston RIA
summary: Newly formed RIA consolidator Accelerated Wealth Partners announced its debut deal, taking a stake in a Houston-based registered investment advisor overseeing roughly $1.6 billion in client assets.

headline: U.S. P&C insurers' underwriting profits look to have peaked in 2025 as growth cools into 2026
summary: Industry analysis shows property-casualty insurers' returns hitting a high point in 2025, with premium growth expected to slow and competition intensifying as the softer-pricing cycle continues through 2026.

headline: Reinsurance rates keep softening through April renewals despite Middle East war-risk spike
summary: Property catastrophe reinsurance pricing continued to decline at April renewals on ample capacity and lower catastrophe losses, even as war-risk premiums for Middle East shipping routes jumped following regional tensions.

headline: GEICO names David Foy chief financial officer, completing its leadership overhaul
summary: GEICO appointed insurance-industry veteran David Foy, formerly CFO of White Mountains Insurance Group and Hartford Life, as its new chief financial officer, filling the last major gap in the carrier's rebuilt executive team under CEO Nancy Pierce.

headline: Texas TPA Proficient Benefit Solutions adopts Elevate's AI-powered benefits platform
summary: Third-party administrator Proficient Benefit Solutions partnered with Elevate to modernize its HSA, FSA and HRA administration for employer clients across Texas using an automated, AI-powered technology platform.

headline: Arch RoamRight embeds travel insurance directly into TravelJoy's advisor booking platform
summary: Arch RoamRight partnered with travel-planning platform TravelJoy so travel advisors can quote and sell its travel insurance policies without leaving their existing booking workflow.

headline: Lloyd's unveils "Accelerate 2030" AI strategy as London market races to keep pace
summary: Lloyd's launched a market-wide AI strategy and adoption toolkit to help managing agents build governance frameworks for artificial intelligence, part of a broader push among the UK's largest financial institutions to deploy AI faster.

headline: CMS finalizes higher-than-proposed Medicare Advantage payment rates for 2027
summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services locked in a 2.48% average Medicare Advantage rate increase for 2027, well above the 0.09% initially proposed, delivering billions of dollars in additional payments to private insurers.

headline: Israel's Sheba Medical Center becomes OpenAI's first international hospital-wide AI deployment
summary: Sheba Medical Center partnered with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT for Healthcare across its clinical, research and operational teams, becoming the first hospital outside the U.S. with direct access to OpenAI's dedicated healthcare AI models.

headline: WellSpan Health expands its Hippocratic AI partnership across clinical operations
summary: WellSpan Health broadened its multi-year partnership with generative voice AI company Hippocratic AI to support more clinical operations and improve the patient experience across its health system.

headline: CNO Financial raises 2026 profit guidance after a blowout annuity quarter
summary: CNO Financial Group's operating earnings per share jumped 45% year-over-year in Q2 2026 on record annuity premiums and fixed indexed annuity growth, prompting the insurer to lift its full-year earnings outlook by roughly 8% at the midpoint.

headline: Shareholders clear the way for Corebridge and Equitable's $22 billion tie-up
summary: Stockholders of both Corebridge Financial and Equitable Holdings voted overwhelmingly to approve their all-stock merger, moving the combined retirement, life and asset-management platform - projected at roughly $1.5 trillion in AUM - closer to a year-end closing.

headline: Pacific Life Re inks a third Japanese block-reinsurance deal with a Tokio Marine unit
summary: Pacific Life Re completed its third asset-intensive block reinsurance transaction with Tokio Marine & Nichido's Anshin Life, absorbing in-force whole-of-life policies to help the Japanese insurer trim long-term interest-rate risk.

headline: LIC installs a new finance chief and risk officer weeks ahead of quarterly results
summary: India's Life Insurance Corporation named Shatmanyu Shrivastava as chief financial officer and Varadarajan Muthuvenkataraman as chief risk officer effective July 28, 2026, rounding out its finance and risk leadership just before its Q1 FY27 earnings.

headline: UK annuity rates climb to their highest in nearly two decades
summary: Standard Life reported that annuity rates for a healthy 65-year-old rose to roughly 7.75% in July 2026, an 18-year high, as insurers keep passing through elevated gilt yields to retirees converting pension pots into guaranteed income.

headline: PBGC's swelling $62 billion surplus stokes a push to cut pension premiums
summary: A widening surplus at the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation is fueling pressure from plan sponsors and advocacy groups to reform single-employer premium levels, which critics say no longer match the agency's shrinking risk exposure.

headline: UK's new Pension Schemes Act rewrites the rules for workplace DC saving
summary: The Pension Schemes Act 2026 has become law, creating a trustee duty to offer default retirement-income solutions for defined-contribution savers and setting new scale requirements for multi-employer default arrangements from 2030.

headline: Pooled employer plans nearly double as recordkeepers chase small-plan growth
summary: The number of employers using pooled employer plans for 401(k) or 403(b) coverage jumped almost 45% year-over-year to nearly 10,800, per the 2026 PLANSPONSOR Recordkeeping Survey, with many recordkeepers now naming PEPs a top strategic priority.

headline: Retirement giant Voya draws renewed takeover interest
summary: Voya Financial, which manages roughly $350 billion in retirement assets, is reportedly fielding ongoing acquisition interest from suitors including Principal Financial, underscoring continued consolidation appetite in the defined-contribution recordkeeping business.

headline: Recordkeeper JULY expands executive bench with two senior hires
summary: JULY Business Services promoted Blake Willis to president of retirement services and hired Josh Bulgin as its first chief commercial officer, part of a leadership build-out to support the firm's next phase of growth.

headline: Insurer investment outsourcing tops $5.5 trillion as private markets expand
summary: Clearwater Analytics' 2026 Insurance Investment Outsourcing Report found third-party managed general account assets rose 23% year-over-year to $5.5 trillion, with insurers increasingly turning to outside managers for private-markets expertise.

headline: Insurers keep piling into private debt despite tighter spreads
summary: AllianceBernstein's latest insurance-investor commentary argues that private debt remains attractive for insurers matching long-duration liabilities, even as compressed illiquidity premiums make manager selection and structuring more important than ever.

headline: AI-focused startups swallow nearly all of Q1 insurtech funding
summary: Gallagher Re's Global InsurTech Report found AI-centered companies captured a record 95.2% of the $1.63 billion raised by insurtechs in Q1 2026, as investors concentrate capital on AI-driven underwriting, claims and investment tools.

headline: MassMutual cashes in part of its Barings stake to a Japanese insurer
summary: MassMutual sold an 18% equity stake in asset manager Barings to Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance's parent MS&AD for about $1.44 billion, retaining 82% ownership and control while monetizing part of its embedded asset-management value.

headline: Manulife Wealth names new president and CEO in leadership shake-up
summary: Manulife Wealth & Asset Management said Brett Marchand will become president and CEO of Manulife Wealth, succeeding Richard McIntyre, as part of a broader round of leadership changes across its wealth and retirement businesses.

headline: LPL Financial's $2.7B Commonwealth deal and Osaic's CW Advisors buy headline a wave of mega RIA mergers
summary: Two of the largest wealth-management M&A deals in years closed within weeks of each other, with LPL Financial absorbing roughly 2,900 advisors and $285 billion in assets from Commonwealth Financial Network, while Osaic picked up Boston-based RIA platform CW Advisors and its $13.5 billion book.

headline: Sovereign wealth fund Mubadala takes full control of $27.7B RIA Evoke Advisors via MAI Capital
summary: MAI Capital closed its purchase of Los Angeles-based Evoke Advisors, marking what's reported as the first time a sovereign wealth fund has taken full ownership of a major North American wealth manager, with Mubadala pledging $5 billion in growth capital over three years.

headline: Arca Wealth raises $48.5M to rip out legacy software from over $1B of RIA roll-ups
summary: Arca Wealth secured fresh growth capital to migrate the firms it has acquired onto a new AI-driven technology stack, though some industry critics argue the model is a repackaged version of an existing RIA consolidation playbook.

headline: Wells Fargo debuts Advisor Gateway with AI-generated portfolio commentary
summary: The new tool gives Wells Fargo advisors on-demand client proposals and real-time portfolio analytics, including a generative-AI "Auto Commentary" feature built on BlackRock's Aladdin Wealth platform.

headline: Mumbai to host 14th India Wealth Management Forum with focus on succession, AI and cross-border wealth
summary: The August 12 gathering will bring together CEOs, family-office leaders and advisers from India, Singapore and the UAE to discuss next-gen wealth transfer, HNW insurance and AI adoption in advisory practices.

headline: Cincinnati Financial misses earnings as combined ratio worsens to 100.8% in Q2
summary: The insurer's underwriting profitability deteriorated by nearly six points from the prior year, partly due to a rise in catastrophe losses, leaving second-quarter results short of analyst expectations.

headline: Canadian insurer Definity beats earnings estimates even as its combined ratio ticks up
summary: Definity's operating net income rose over 10% year-on-year to C$118 million in Q2, outperforming forecasts despite a modest deterioration in underwriting margin.

headline: Homeowners insurance premiums projected to climb 16% cumulatively through 2027
summary: Even after a moderation from the sharp increases of 2023-2024, U.S. homeowners can expect continued rate hikes over the next two years, while auto insurance relief is expected to be limited mostly to the safest-rated drivers.

headline: Florida governor touts rate relief for Citizens Property Insurance policyholders
summary: Governor Ron DeSantis announced that state insurance reforms are translating into meaningful premium reductions for Citizens Property Insurance customers starting at spring renewal.
source_name: Florida Executive Office of the Governor

headline: Japan, Korea and India reinsurance buyers lock in double-digit rate cuts at April renewals
summary: Ample capacity and a stretch of relatively low catastrophe activity gave Asia-Pacific cedents strong leverage at the April 1 renewal, with global reinsurance demand also climbing about 10% as buyers sought broader protection.

headline: Private equity-backed Vistria buys specialty MGA Lumen to expand into niche underwriting
summary: The deal gives Vistria a platform to grow in the fast-expanding specialty managing general agent segment, which continues to draw private capital drawn to its asset-light, fee-based economics.

headline: Gallagher Re promotes Russell Hails to lead its APAC managing general agent push
summary: The veteran broker's expanded role puts him in charge of building out Gallagher Re's MGA proposition across the Pacific, one of reinsurance's fastest-growing distribution channels.

headline: AI-focused MGA Mile Auto expands with acquisition of Insurance House
summary: The combined operation now serves more than 55,000 policyholders through roughly 1,600 independent agencies across ten states, adding scale to Mile Auto's technology-driven underwriting model.

headline: Amwins adds occupational-risk specialist MGA Jackson-Lloyd to its portfolio
summary: The wholesale giant continues to build out niche underwriting capabilities through bolt-on acquisitions, this time picking up a specialty MGA focused on occupational loss protection.

headline: Gallagher's wholesale unit RPS buys Kansas MGA Med James as consolidation of general agencies continues
summary: Risk Placement Services' purchase of the wholesale broker and MGA is part of a broader trend of large brokerages snapping up managing general agencies to expand specialty distribution reach.

headline: Retirement-plan TPA consolidation continues as Fiduciary Services Group buys Pension Investors Corp
summary: The parent of DWC – The 401(k) Experts is absorbing a Florida-based administrator overseeing about 900 retirement plans, folding the business into its existing TPA operations.

headline: Global insurance TPA market revenue jumps $32 billion as AI-driven claims automation takes hold
summary: A new market report credits the surge in outsourced claims administration to insurers adopting AI-based automation and scalable TPA platforms, projecting continued double-digit growth through 2030.

headline: Colorado shifts workers' comp claims reporting to new EDI 3.1 standard for carriers and TPAs
summary: Colorado's Division of Workers' Compensation moved its electronic data interchange requirement to the newer EDI 3.1 format in July, requiring carriers and third-party administrators to update claims-submission systems.

headline: Corgi Insurance teams up with Silicon Valley Bank to embed startup coverage into banking relationships
