summary: AI-native commercial insurer Corgi struck a partnership with Silicon Valley Bank so SVB's startup clients can access Corgi's digital insurance and risk-management tools directly through their banking relationship.

headline: Spanish insurer Mapfre buys a 38.9% stake in digital insurance distributor Tuio
summary: Mapfre agreed to take a significant minority stake in Tuio, a specialist digital insurance distribution platform built around advanced AI capabilities, deepening the insurer's push into tech-driven distribution.

headline: Convex Group launches Kinetic, a new technology-enabled specialty MGA
summary: Lloyd's-focused insurer Convex Group unveiled Kinetic Insurance Services, a wholly owned managing general agency built to trade specialty and niche lines using Convex's underwriting technology, with UK regulatory approval secured.

headline: Insurers start rolling out policies to cover damages caused by AI systems
summary: As businesses adopt AI more aggressively, insurers and MGAs are launching new specialty products designed to cover losses and liability arising specifically from AI system failures and errors, filling a gap left by traditional coverage.

headline: Ardonagh Group launches Axiiem to digitize specialty insurance placement
summary: UK broking group Ardonagh unveiled Axiiem, a new digital trading platform meant to connect data, distribution and underwriting capacity so brokers and carriers can place specialty risks faster and more transparently.

headline: UnitedHealth stock jumps after insurer tops estimates and lifts its 2026 profit forecast
summary: UnitedHealth shares surged roughly 10% after the company beat quarterly expectations and raised its full-year earnings outlook, with executives citing improving medical-cost trends.

headline: Elevance Health rolls out an AI-driven cancer-care coordination program
summary: Elevance Health launched an enhanced oncology support model that pairs predictive analytics with certified nurse navigators to steer cancer patients toward the right care and cut avoidable hospital stays.

headline: Federal marketplace crackdown set to strip coverage from up to 1.8 million ACA enrollees
summary: A batch of Trump administration ACA marketplace rules takes effect August 25, tightening eligibility verification, ending some special enrollment periods and cutting DACA recipients from subsidized coverage, though litigation could still block parts of it.
source_name: Georgetown Center on Health Insurance Reforms

headline: Molina raises profit guidance as Medicaid costs steady, but keeps shrinking its ACA book
summary: Molina Healthcare bumped its annual earnings forecast after Medicaid trends stabilized in the second quarter, even as it plans to pull roughly $1 billion of premium out of ACA exchange markets in 2027.

headline: Baylor Scott & White's health plan retreats from Texas Medicaid and ACA markets, cutting 321 jobs
summary: Baylor Scott & White Health Plan is exiting the individual marketplace and Medicaid managed care business in Texas by the end of August, eliminating 321 positions as it refocuses on Medicare Advantage and employer coverage.

headline: India's health insurance premiums surge nearly 27% as GST cut and government schemes drive volume
summary: Health insurance gross written premiums in India jumped sharply at the start of 2026, helped by a GST reduction on retail policies and expanded enrollment in government schemes such as Ayushman Bharat.

headline: IRDAI's one-hour cashless claim mandate shows uneven compliance across insurers
summary: India's insurance regulator's rule requiring insurers to clear cashless pre-authorization within an hour is now being met in about 87% of cases, per 2026 regulatory data, with some insurers still lagging on turnaround times.

headline: Cigna's leadership handoff becomes official as Evanko takes the CEO seat from Cordani
summary: Brian Evanko formally became Cigna's chief executive on July 1, succeeding David Cordani, who moves into the executive chair role after nearly three decades leading the insurer.

headline: UPMC to absorb four Ohio hospitals as CommonSpirit exits the Trinity Health System
summary: UPMC signed a definitive agreement to take over Trinity Health System's four Ohio Valley hospitals and clinics from CommonSpirit Health, marking UPMC's first entry into Ohio, with the deal expected to close this fall.

headline: Samaritan-MultiCare tie-up in the Pacific Northwest edges toward regulatory sign-off
summary: The planned combination of Oregon's Samaritan Health Services and Washington-based MultiCare Health System, which would create an 18-hospital system, is moving through state regulatory review with an August timeline for next steps.

headline: Wellstar Health System cuts 761 corporate jobs in one of 2026's largest health-system layoffs
summary: Georgia-based Wellstar Health System eliminated 761 corporate and administrative roles, about 2% of its workforce, while stating frontline clinical staff were not affected.

headline: Kaiser-backed Risant Health loses its founding CEO as Ryu steps aside
summary: Jaewon Ryu is stepping down as CEO of Risant Health, the Kaiser Permanente subsidiary that acquires and operates nonprofit hospital systems, with retired Presbyterian Healthcare Services chief Dale Maxwell taking over on an interim basis during a national search.

headline: Singapore's AI scribe tool spreads across the country's public hospital clusters
summary: Note Buddy, an ambient AI documentation tool built with Microsoft and Synapxe, has expanded beyond SingHealth to Singapore's other public healthcare clusters, with thousands of clinicians now using it to cut charting time.

headline: FDA fast-tracks review of a rare-disease drug that could change care for a devastating bone disorder
summary: The FDA granted priority review to garetosmab for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva after a phase 3 trial showed it significantly cut abnormal bone growth and flare-ups, a decision hospitals treating this ultra-rare condition are watching closely.
